decisions.name: 5th Avenue Cigars
decisions.reason: Open and in scope, but with a noted caveat. Confirmed trading: the shop's own site avenuecigars.com is live with staffed hours (Mon-Sat 10am-8pm, Sun 3pm-9pm), phone 907-274-7473, and an active membership lounge ('Lounge On 5th'). Yelp page was updated September 2026 and carries a review dated 29 June 2026; aggregate 4.8 stars across ~117 reviews. Scope is clean: 'Alaska's largest walk-in humidor, and largest cigar selection', premium cigars plus pipes, cutters, lighters, humidors and pipe tobacco — a tobacconist, not a vape/head shop. CAVEATS I could not fully clear: (a) us-info.com's 'Avenue Cigars LLC' listing, dated 4 August 2026, shows status 'Closed' — I judge this a scraped open-right-now flag from a low-quality aggregator rather than a permanent-closure marker, since nothing else corroborates it; (b) the site footer reads '© 2022 By Dakota Wills', so the site itself is stale; (c) Yelp's hours (Mon-Sat 10-6) disagree with the site's (10-8 + Sunday). Yelp, Google, Facebook and Roadtrippers carry no CLOSED or 'Permanently closed' marker. One directory (headshops.puffingbird.com) files it as a 'headshop', but that site indexes all tobacco retailers and the shop's own trade is plainly premium cigars.

decisions.name: The Black Leaf Cigar Company
decisions.reason: Positively confirmed open and squarely in scope. I fetched the Birmingham Times feature directly: published 22 July 2026, it describes The Black Leaf as an actively operating lounge founded by James Spencer, with a 'large, walk-in, specialty humidor' stocking boutique brands. The same paper's 26 July 2026 roundup (which I also fetched) lists it at 1509 3rd Ave West, (205) 777-4500, as a 'back-to-the-basics cigar lounge that caters to members and features a custom, triple-insulated humidor with boutique cigars'. Scope is the strongest of the seven: premium hand-rolled cigars only — no vapes, no cigarettes, no hookah, and per the feature Spencer deliberately does not even serve liquor or book music, calling it a 'smokers' smokers' venue. Current hours Thu-Sun (Thu/Fri 4-10pm, Sat 2-10pm, Sun 2-7pm). No CLOSED marker on Yelp, Facebook or Roadtrippers. Only soft negative: the Yelp page title now reads 'Updated October 2025' rather than 2026, but that is outweighed by two independent July 2026 newspaper items.

decisions.name: Cigars & More
decisions.reason: Positively confirmed, and I resolved the identity question the reviewer raised — plus surfaced a rebrand the directory should know about. birminghamcigars.com now 301-redirects to vitolafinecigars.com: the company is migrating its brand from 'Cigars & More' to 'Vitola Fine Cigars'. That current first-party site still lists the Hoover store as a live location — 'Cigars & More Patton Creek (Hoover), 160 Main Street Suite 100, Hoover, AL 35244', hours Mon-Sat 10am-8pm, Sun 12-7pm — alongside Cigars & More 280/Inverness, Cigars & More Trussville, Vitola Mountain Brook and Vitola Tuscaloosa. Independently confirmed by the Birmingham Times roundup of 26 July 2026, which I fetched: '160 Main St #100, Hoover, (205) 982-3198 ... popular destination for cigar enthusiasts ... wide array of premium cigars ... well-ventilated space with comfortable seating, large TVs, and an outdoor patio'. Yelp updated July 2026, ~4.8 stars over 296 Google reviews. Scope is clean: Tobacconists' Association of America exclusive retailer carrying Padron, Davidoff, Fuente, Opus X, Plasencia, AJ Fernandez, Liga Privada. The 'Magic City Cigars' Yelp page at the same address and phone is a superseded name for the same premises, not a competing tenant. DIRECTORY NOTE, not a refutation: expect this branch to be renamed 'Vitola Fine Cigars' at some point; one aggregator already lists a Patton Creek address of 4445 Creekside Ave, which conflicts with the operator's own 160 Main St and should be ignored.

decisions.name: Blaque Cigar Lounge
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED ON SCOPE. It is trading (Yelp updated June 2026, a 30 March 2026 review, Huntsville CVB listing live), so this is not a dead-listing problem — it is that the primary trade is not cigars. Its own site self-describes as 'a full service lounge, bar, and restaurant' whose draw is 'Premium spirits, handcrafted signature cocktails and gourmet bites'. I fetched its own MENU page: it is entirely food and drink — a 'BITES' section, flatbreads, brunch, Blaque'n Mild Wings $19, Chicken & Waffles with bourbon maple syrup $17, craft cocktails, beer and wine list — with no cigar list, no humidor section, no tobacco pricing anywhere on it. Every category signal agrees: Yelp files it under 'Lounges' with Restaurant Reviews, wheree under 'Cocktail Bar', Roadtrippers under food-drink, and it is indexed as a restaurant by Zmenu, Sirved, MenuPix, Restaurantji (162 reviews) and Restaurant Guru (532 reviews, 4.1). Hours are bar hours: 11am-12am weekdays, to 2am Fri-Sat. Reviewers who do mention the humidor say the cigar options are 'limited', and at least one review describes ordering hookah there — hookah service is itself on the owner's exclusion list. This is a bar/restaurant that keeps a small humidor and a smoking room, which is the same shape as the canonical 'Mary Jane's House of Glass' rejection: a business in another trade that happens to sell cigars. The word 'Cigar' in the name is not the trade test.

decisions.name: SiP Fine Spirits & Cigar Lounge
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED ON SCOPE. Like Blaque, it is open — but it is a whiskey bar with a cigar room attached, not a tobacconist. I fetched its own site: the self-description is 'Huntsville's premier destination for refined taste and timeless sophistication' offering 'world-class whiskeys, handcrafted cocktails, and premium cigars' — spirits first, cigars third — and the site carries no mention of a retail humidor or over-the-counter cigar sales at all. The name itself leads with 'Fine Spirits'. It bills itself as home to the largest single-barrel whiskey selection in Alabama. The hours are bar hours with no daytime retail window at all: Mon-Thu 3pm-11pm, Fri-Sat 3pm-1am, and Sunday PRIVATE EVENTS ONLY — a shop whose primary trade was cigars would open in the morning. Third-party categorisation is unanimous: Yelp files it under 'Cocktail Bars', wheree under 'Cocktail Bars', and the Huntsville/Madison County Chamber lists it under 'Food / Drink | Beverage - Beer / Ale | Bottlers / Breweries / Beverages | Wine' with no tobacco or tobacconist category. Secondary concern on freshness: the newest Yelp signal is March 2026, roughly six months old, the weakest of the seven. The genuine ventilated cigar lounge and walk-in humidor are real amenities for drinkers, but under the owner's rule the primary trade must be cigars or pipe tobacco, and here it is spirits.

decisions.name: Sun of a Gun Cigars
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED ON SCOPE, not on closure - it is definitely open, but I do not think it clears the owner's 'primary trade is cigars' bar without a human call. Scope evidence against: the venue's own sitemap (sunofaguncigars.com, fetched 2026-09-13) carries dedicated pages for /hookah-menu, /cbd-cbg, /beer, /beer-menu, /curated-cocktail and /fine-spirits alongside the cigar pages - hookah and CBD/hemp are both on the owner's explicit not-in-scope list, and the contact page's lead selling point is 'the largest top-shelf whiskey, scotch, bourbon, tequila, and mezcal selection within a 200-mile radius' rather than the humidor. Its Yuma County Chamber of Commerce member record (fetched live, membership current) files it under category 'Bar' with the description 'Fine crafter cocktail Bar and cigar lounge'. Third-party names reinforce the hybrid identity: Apple Maps 'Sun Of A Gun Smoke & Cigar Lounge', Waze 'Sun Of A Gun Cigars & Fine Spirits, Bar - Wine, Cocktails & Beer Garden - Smoke Shop', Facebook 'Sun Of A Gun Cigar, Beer & Wine Bar' emphasising a 'large selection of beers'; it trades to 1 AM Thu-Sat like a bar, not a tobacconist. Counter-evidence the parent should weigh before dropping it: the site does carry a deep premium-cigar catalogue (Opus X incl. Lost City, Padron, Arturo Fuente, Don Carlos, Ashton, Diamond Crown, God of Fire, Drew Estate/Liga Privada, My Father, La Flor Dominicana, AJ Fernandez, El Septimo), self-describes as 'the only full-service tobacconist in Yuma' with the largest walk-in humidor, and the /hookah-menu URL now renders under the title 'Craft Beverages', suggesting hookah may have been retired. Openness itself is not in doubt (chamber membership current, site hours live, Facebook live, Drew Estate in-store events page).

(2) It is not a zombie site: the WordPress/WooCommerce product sitemap has lastmod 2026-09-11T04:16Z, with new SKUs published 2026-09-08 (P26 Aureum) and 2026-09-11 (Cohiba Maduro DC) - inventory touched two days ago. decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED ON SCOPE - it is an online cigar seller with a will-call office suite, not a shop. The other researcher's own caveat is correct and I can now settle it with records. (1) City of Los Angeles 'Listing of Active Businesses' (dataset refreshed 2026-08-15) has: INTERNATIONAL NOBLE GROUP INC, dba CIGAR INC, 21900 BURBANK BLVD SUITE #265, WOODLAND HILLS 91367, NAICS description 'Other health & personal care stores', start 2016-01-22, no end date - active, but not classified as a retail store. (2) The same dataset shows what 21900 Burbank Blvd is: ~40 registered businesses at that address, and they are law firms, CPAs, mortgage brokers, home-health agencies, property managers and a Regus - it is an office tower. Suite #265 itself also hosts 'RALLY INVESTMENT INC / RALLY INVEST', NAICS 'Electronic shopping'. (3) cigarinc.com's own shipping policy page (fetched 2026-09-13) says 'Pickup available at 21900 Burbank Boulevard, Unit #265' - order collection, not browsing. Hours everywhere on the site are 'Mon-Fri, 9:30 am. - 5:30 pm', Saturday and Sunday closed. No cigar shop or lounge on earth is shut both weekend days and closed by 5:30pm; those are office hours. (4) The site's navigation is pure e-commerce - 'Los Angeles Local Delivery', 'Complimentary Shipping on Orders Over $250', 'Cigar Finder' - with no humidor, walk-in, lounge or in-store language anywhere on the home, about, contact or shipping pages. (5) Its Shopify feed (/products.json) returns 250 products with updated_at 2026-09-13, i.e. the business is certainly alive - and its catalogue leads with Raching humidor cabinets and accessories. So: trading, but as an online/mail-order retailer, which the owner's rule excludes. The Yelp 'Cigar Bars' category is a miscategorisation of an office suite.

decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED ON DOUBT - its web presence is dead and nothing dates after February 2026. (1) smolderlounge.com serves a Namecheap parking page ('has been recently registered with namecheap.com', plus Namecheap domain-auction promos). RDAP at Verisign shows the domain was created 2020-10-30, expires 2026-10-30, last changed 2025-10-01 - so the owners still hold and renew it, but the website behind it is gone. The '$20 day pass, $40-$80/month, $350-$750/year' membership tariff the other researcher cited is not reachable anywhere now. (2) I probed smoldercigarlounge.com, smolderlounge.net/.org/.co, smoldercigar(s).com, thesmolderlounge.com, smolderaurora.com, smolderloungeco.com, square.site and wixsite variants - all NXDOMAIN or 404. No alternative live site exists. (3) The newest evidence of any kind is the Yelp 'Updated February 2026', seven months old, and that title carries a photo count but no review count. For a membership-based lounge, a dead site plus seven months of silence is a real reason to doubt. IN FAIRNESS, what points the other way: Colorado SOS business-entity data (file refreshed 2026-09-12) shows 'Smolder Cigar Lounge LLC' in Good Standing at 22691 E Aurora Pkwy Unit B4, Aurora 80016 - an exact match to the listing - and 'Smolder Foundation' in Good Standing at '22691 E Aurora Pkwy Unit B4 Smolder Lounge'; and Colorado's Tobacco Licenses file carries 'SMOLDER / SMOLDER LOUNGE LLC / Tobacco Retailer Indoor Age Restricted / 22691 EAST AURORA PARKWAY #B4', which is the age-restricted on-premises class that only real cigar lounges hold. So if it IS open it is squarely in scope. But a Colorado periodic report is a $10 annual filing and does not evidence trading, and the state licence file is a January 2025 snapshot. On the owner's 'rather drop a good shop than keep a dead one' rule, this one should be dropped or re-checked by phone: (720) area listing, 22691 E Aurora Pkwy Unit B4.

decisions.reason: Confirmed in scope and, on the best evidence available, trading - but with one anomaly the owner should know about. (1) The listing's website domain oldwestcigar.com redirects to www.smokeme.com, which I fetched 2026-09-13: a complete, coherent site titled 'Old West Cigar & Tobacco', address '225 East Pikes Peak Avenue, Colorado Springs, 80903', phone 719-635-0211, footer 'Store Hours: M-F 10-6 ~ Saturday 10-5'. Its Member Lounge page quotes a live tariff ('Annual dues are just $35.00, with day trial passes available for $5.00... a cigar purchase and membership are required'), and the About page names the current operator: 'founded by Georgianna Lee in 1995. Currently son Mike Lee manages and operates the retail shop and members lounge.' Separate pages for Our Cigar Brands ('properly maintained humidor') and Pipes & Tobacco. That is a tobacconist, not a smoke/vape/head shop. (2) Colorado SOS records pulled 2026-09-13 (trade-name file refreshed that morning): trade name 'Old West Cigar Co.' status GOOD, registrant OLD WEST SUPPLY, INC. at 229 E Pikes Peak Ave, Colorado Springs 80903; that corporation is in Good Standing, formed 1994-02-22 - which matches the 'since 1995' claim. ANOMALY TO FLAG: it does not appear in Colorado's Tobacco Licenses file at all. That file has 4,910 rows statewide and 475 in Colorado Springs, and it does contain peer premium tobacconist Stag Tobacconist (Indoor Age Restricted); there is no tobacco licence of any kind on the 200-block of E Pikes Peak Ave. Also the site footer still reads 'Copyright. 2025'. I could not resolve whether that is a gap in a one-off January-2025 publication or a genuine lapse, because Yelp and Google both refuse automated fetches (403) and search was unavailable. Not enough to overturn a live, specific, currently-staffed site plus GOOD registry status, but it is the one thing I would spot-check by phone.

(1) Colorado's Tobacco Licenses file: the licensed tobacco retailer at 707 EAST 6TH AVENUE, Denver 80203 is 'SMOKER FRIENDLY 182', licensee THE CIGARETTE STORE LLC. (2) Colorado's trade-name register (file refreshed 2026-09-13) settles who owns the brand: trade name 'Cigars on 6th', status GOOD, registrant 'The Cigarette Store LLC', 6790 Winchester Cir, Boulder CO 80301 - Smoker Friendly's head office. decisions.name: City Cigar Lounge
decisions.reason: Could not refute on openness, and the state record is stronger than the first-party evidence the other pass used. Florida DBPR holds TWO current licences at this exact door, both DBA 'CITY CIGAR LOUNGE', owner ARTI ENTERTAINMENT LLC, premises '41 NW 2 ST, MIAMI FL 33128': retail-tobacco permit TOB2332302 (exp 01/15/2027) and 4COP liquor licence BEV2302411 (exp 03/31/2027, Smoking Designation 'SSF' = licensed stand-alone smoking facility, Retail Tobacco Indicator DUAL). Both Primary Status Current, both with transactions effective 06/19/2026 - three months ago. Sunbiz: ARTI ENTERTAINMENT LLC (L18000211803) ACTIVE, principal address changed TO '41 NW 2nd St Miami FL 33128' on 05/01/2026, 2026 annual report filed 01 May 2026 and amended 02 May 2026. The operator is expanding, not closing: the same owner licensed 'CITY CIGAR BY THE BAY' (3387 Pan American Dr, TOB2333955) and 'CITY CIGAR & LIQUOR' (Pinecrest, TOB2333956), both effective 03/18/2026. Its own contact page, fetched today, reads 'Cigar Lounge: 742 SW 16th Ave, Miami, FL 33135' under a 'Visit US' heading. So the permit, the corporate filing and the shop all point at one location, six months ago. decisions.name: My Tobacconist Smoke Shop
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED ON SCOPE. It is trading - DBPR permit TOB2331371 'MY TOBACCONIST' at 9869 E Fern St is Primary Status Current to 01/15/2027, and Sunbiz shows MY TOBACCONIST INC (P08000080392) ACTIVE with its 2026 annual report filed 11 Mar 2026 - but it is not a cigar shop under the owner's rule. I fetched the site myself today rather than trust the summary. The page is headed 'My Tobacconist | Palmetto Bay - More Than a Smoke Shop' and opens 'Welcome to My Tobacconist Smoke Shop!'. The complete navigation is Tobacco / Pipes / Hookahs / Paper & Wraps / Incense & Aromatherapy / Events / More Cool Stuff. There is no cigar category and no humidor anywhere on it; the word 'cigar' occurs three times on the whole page and every occurrence is 'cigar wraps', i.e. blunt wraps. decisions.name: St Lucie Smoke & Cigars
decisions.where: 914 SW Gatlin Blvd, Port St Lucie, FL, 34953
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED ON SCOPE, not on closure — it is trading (FL DBPR lists ST LUCIE SMOKE & CIGARS, owner ST LUCIE SMOKE & CIGARS LLC, 914 SW GATLIN BLVD, PORT ST LUCIE 34953, status Active, series RTPD). The first researcher flagged this as borderline and invited the flip; the shop's own About page settles it against them. In its own words it is "a trusted and reputable smoke shop" in Port St. Lucie, "formerly known as S & M Smoke Shop", and its stated ranges are cigars, pipes/pipe tobacco AND "e-liquids and vaping devices, including the latest innovations in the market". The name leads with "Smoke", the prior trading name was a smoke shop outright, and "Vapes, Vaporizers, E-Vapes & Accessories" is a top-level category on the homepage, not a counter afterthought — raw-HTML counts are cigar 36 against vape 13 plus e-vape 6, so roughly a third of the product language is vape. That is a smoke shop with a good cigar selection, which is the owner's canonical "Mary Jane's House of Glass" rejection applied to vape rather than glass. Two supporting doubts: the site footer is "© 2023" (no 2026 content of its own — the only 2026 evidence is state filings), and 914 SW Gatlin Blvd sits in a strip that already carries Mr. Smoke and Smokes Smoke Shop on the same boulevard, which is the company this listing keeps. Drop it.

decisions.name: Central Cigars
decisions.reason: This was the one I nearly refuted, so the reasoning matters. THE DOUBT I FOUND: the shop's own domain centralcigars.com is dead - it now serves a 114-byte lander that redirects to forsale.godaddy.com (RDAP: registrar GoDaddy, last changed 2026-07-04), and the Wayback CDX shows its last substantive capture was Feb 2025 with only a 543-byte capture in Nov 2025. That plus the prior researcher's own note that the /events page shows nothing upcoming looked like a dying business. WHAT RESOLVED IT: the operator did not vanish, it migrated. rubyselixirdtsp.com was registered 2025-12-14 (RDAP, Porkbun) - which is also why it has zero Wayback history - and fetched today (2026-09-13) it presents "Two Distinct Experiences Under One Roof", names Central Cigars in the present tense as "Florida's premier destination for hand-selected premium cigars and accessories", states OPEN DAILY 6PM-3AM, shows a September 2026 live-music calendar and a 2026 copyright, at 15 3rd St N. Two independent government sources back that: the Florida DABT extract downloaded today lists "CENTRAL CIGARS", owner HOOKED INC, at "273 CENTRAL AVE & 15 3RD ST, ST. PETERSBURG 33701" - the licence itself couples the two addresses, matching the one-roof arrangement - series 4COP, Retail Tobacco Indicator DUAL, Primary Status 20 (current); and CCKS, LLC holds a separate current RTPD retail-tobacco-dealer permit at 273 CENTRAL AVENUE, Status 20, expiring 01/15/2027. Both operating entities are ACTIVE at the Division of Corporations with 2026 annual reports filed (HOOKED, INC. P95000047817 on 02/05/2026; CCKS, LLC L11000104917 on 04/03/2026). YellowPages also still lists "Central Cigars, 273 Central Ave" under Cigar/Pipes & Smokers Articles with no closed flag. SCOPE: cigar retail is separately licensed at the 273 Central Ave door; the full bar is the co-located, separately branded Ruby's Elixir. FLAGS TO PASS ON: the CENTRAL CIGARS beverage licence expires 09/30/2026, 17 days from now, while most comparable licences I saw run to 09/30/2027 - worth a re-check in October; and the dead primary domain means a directory link to centralcigars.com would send users to a for-sale page and should be repointed. LIMITATION: Yelp/Google/Facebook/TripAdvisor/Foursquare unreachable (403) and web search exhausted, so no review-recency check.

decisions.name: Black Leaf Cigar and Wine Lounge
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: Refuted on SCOPE, not on closure - it is plainly trading, so do not drop this as dead. Trading is settled: the events calendar served today shows September 2026 dates either side of the audit (Sep 11, 12 past; Sep 25, 26 still ahead), the Florida extract downloaded today carries BEV6200655 at 237 2ND AVE S, ST. PETERSBURG 33701, status 20/20, and Sunbiz shows BLACK LEAF CIGAR AND WINE BAR, INC. (P23000082802) Active. The doubt is whether cigars are its PRIMARY trade. Against scope: the licence is a 4COP - full liquor, consumption on premises - and there is NO standalone retail tobacco dealer permit at the address, unlike id 245 and id 703 which both hold an RTPD; the RTI=DUAL flag on a beverage licence is worth little, since the 7-Eleven at 1535 E 7th Ave carries the same flag. The homepage ranks its own draws as 'fine wines, expertly crafted cocktails, captivating live entertainment, and premium cigars' - cigars fourth of five, after which it adds 'our bespoke barbershop'. The hero feature is a self-service wine-dispensing card system. Hours are 5pm to 10pm/midnight, closed Sunday and Monday: bar hours, not a tobacconist's. The happy-hour page is cocktails and $20 wine flights with a single incidental cigar mention; bottle service is $175-$400 spirits; the September calendar is live concerts, an R&B day party and a sneaker ball, with zero cigar events. Word counts across its pages run wine and spirits ahead of cigars on every page except one. For scope: the name leads with 'Cigar', and the membership page is a genuine cigar-lounge offer - $85/month or $1,020/year for a humidified cigar locker with a nameplate and 20-25% off cigar box purchases, which a mere wine bar would not run. So it is a real cigar lounge in part, but the weight of its trade reads as alcohol and entertainment with cigars as an amenity. Per the owner's rule that primary trade must be cigars or pipe tobacco, and that doubt is a reason to drop, I refute - flagging that this is a judgement call on primacy that the owner may want to overrule, since it is not a vape, smoke, head or hookah shop and it does sell cigars by the box.

decisions.name: Don Esteban Cigars
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED — two independent problems. (1) NAME/IDENTITY: the state tobacco permit at the exact listed address is not issued to 'Don Esteban Cigars'. FL DBPR shows DBA 'JAVIS CIGAR SHOP', owner DON ESTEBAN CIGARS INC, at '735 DODECANESE BLVD. SUITE 1000', RTPD, original licensure 02/15/2005, expires 01/15/2027. It has been licensed under that trading name for twenty years, and the site's own testimonials thank 'Javier'. So the storefront on the Sponge Docks trades publicly as Javi's Cigar Shop; 'Don Esteban Cigars' is the brand/company behind it. The listing name is therefore wrong or at best a brand name rather than the shop name. (2) NO 2026 SIGNAL AT ALL — this is the only shop in the batch with nothing dated this year. I pulled the WordPress sitemaps: every product page was last modified in 2020, 2021 or 2024 (newest product touch 2024-07-13), the /shop/ page 2024-08-12, the homepage 2025-10-16 and /cigar-shop-2/ 2025-11-01. The site has no copyright year at all, and the WebFetch pass found image uploads only 2019-2024. Every other shop here has something from 2026; the most recent human edit here is ~11 months old. Add the registry lapse the prior researcher flagged (last Sunbiz event is a REINSTATEMENT) and the fact that the retail presence is a boardwalk booth in a tourist market selling only its own $10 house-rolled line, and 'open, in scope, under this name' is not carried. The active RTPD proves a permit was renewed in Dec 2025/Jan 2026; it does not prove the booth is trading in September 2026.

decisions.name: GarVino's Cigars
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED on SCOPE, not on trading. It is almost certainly open — FL DBPR shows DBA 'GARVINOS' at '1081 CANAL STREET', 2COP, status 20 Active, Retail Tobacco Indicator 'DUAL', expiring 09/30/2027, meaning the annual alcohol licence was renewed inside the current Aug-Sep 2026 window, which is a harder and more recent signal than the Sunbiz filing. But the strict test is 'PRIMARY trade is cigars and/or pipe tobacco', and I read the homepage copy directly: the business lists five lines and puts wine first — 'Wine Bar - The GarVino's Wine Bar features 24 wines by the glass, wine flights, micro-brew and imported beer and light appetizers... in a no-smoking environment', then 'Premium Cigars', then 'Cigar Lounge', then 'Retail Wine Shop - ...over 300 estate bottled and boutique wines', then 'Gifts & Accessories'. The cigar half is real and not incidental (350 varieties in a walk-in humidor, a Diamond Crown Cigar Lounge), but it is at best co-equal with a wine bar plus a 300-bottle retail wine shop, and the only events programme is wine: /events.html renders nothing but 'Special Events Wine Tastings Check back for upcoming wine tasting events' and /entertainment.html is an empty shell with a nav and no schedule. The site is also two years stale ('Web site design by GarVino's LLC - Copyright© 2024') and is on the legacy Homestead builder with no sitemap. On a 50/50 wine-and-cigar hybrid, 'primary trade is cigars' is not established, so under the asymmetric burden I am flagging it for the owner rather than passing it.

decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED on currency, not on scope - I could not positively confirm it is trading now, and the site itself has been frozen for 7 months. Today is 2026-09-13. The WordPress REST API and sitemap agree that NOTHING on sweetbriarcolumbus.com has been edited since 2026-02-10 (home page); Gallery 2025-10-28, Feedback 2025-06-25, Contact 2025-02-19, Services 2023-08-31, Reviews page 2022-08-18, and the blog has exactly one post, from 2022-12-21. The newest media upload of any kind is 2025-10-28 (Perdomo event photos). The homepage today still headlines 'Events - February 21st from 12-5: Cordoba & Morales Cigars event' - a nearly seven-month-dead banner presented as upcoming, which is the profile of a site nobody tends. Every open signal is self-published by the shop: the '(c) 2026' footer is a template year, and the March/May/June 2026 testimonials the other researcher leaned on are entries in the site's own testimonial plugin with a 'Leave a Testimonial' form - the page they sit on was last modified in 2022, so the plugin simply renders whatever date an entry carries. I cannot verify those dates against any independent platform: Yelp 403s, and Facebook/Google/Foursquare/TripAdvisor/Reddit and every general search engine I tried (WebSearch budget exhausted; DuckDuckGo, Brave, Ecosia, Startpage, Mojeek and three SearxNG instances all CAPTCHA'd; Bing served degraded bot results ignoring quoted phrases) were unreachable, and Wayback holds no snapshot of its Yelp or Facebook page. Applying the same test I applied to the other two shops - verified owner/business activity in the last ~3 months - Smokey Bear passes (4 days) and Cigar Studio 57 passes (12 days); Sweetbriar fails at 7 months. IN FAIRNESS: I found NO evidence of closure. YellowPages carries two live listings at 5592 Whitesville Rd (Suite H), both with (706) 322-6467, described as Columbus's oldest tobacco shop, '51 Years in Business' (i.e. counted to 2026), and no other tenant appears at that address. SCOPE WOULD BE FINE: it is a genuine tobacconist - 'Your Premier Cigar and Pipe Store', walk-in humidor, Dominican/Nicaraguan/Honduran premium cigars, briar pipes, loose-leaf and bulk pipe tobacco, with rolling papers and cigarette tubes as a sideline; a testimonial explicitly says 'This is a Cigar Shop. It's not a smoke shop or a vape shop.' So this is a refute on unproven currency under the burden-of-proof rule, and it is the weakest of my three refutals - a single phone call or one reachable third-party review would likely overturn it.

decisions.name: Cigar Studio 57
decisions.reason: NOT REFUTED, but the original researcher's two 'freshness' signals are both worthless and I had to replace them. 'Copyright (c) 2026' and 'Open today 10:00 am - 08:00 pm' are both auto-generated by the GoDaddy Website Builder from the current date and the stored hours - they render identically on a dormant site and prove nothing. What does hold up: cigarstudio-57.com/sitemap.website.xml gives lastmod 2026-09-01 on all four pages (12 days before today, 2026-09-13). I control-tested whether that is platform noise by pulling the same sitemap from six other GoDaddy-hosted cigar shops in this dataset - they returned 2026-03-22, 2026-08-24, 2026-06-15, 2026-08-04, 2026-08-11 and 2026-05-25. The value varies per site and is not 'today', so it reflects a genuine owner-initiated republish on 2026-09-01. Second, I independently corroborated the January 2026 expansion story that the site tells. The site gives 'Cigar Studio 57 Too, 6320 Atlanta Hwy suite 8, Alpharetta, 678-867-2886'. YellowPages independently lists 'Blue Havana II, (678) 867-2886, 6320 Atlanta Hwy, Alpharetta GA 30004, 19 Years in Business', and Blue Havana II's own surviving site at bluehavana2.com carries the same address and phone and the identical sentence Cigar Studio 57 Too now uses ('the premier destination for cigar aficionados in the Alpharetta, Milton and South Forsyth County area, proudly offering one of the most extensive cigar inventories in Georgia'). So they really did take over a long-running Alpharetta cigar shop, matching the 'over 20 years in Alpharetta' claim. SCOPE: in scope - premium cigars, pipe tobacco, accessories, indoor and outdoor lounge seating, a humidor, with beer and wine explicitly ancillary ('a growing assortment of beer and wine'). Not a vape/smoke/head/hookah shop. YellowPages lists it as a Cigar, Cigarette & Tobacco Dealer at 1370 Buford Hwy with the matching phone (770) 844-4224 and no closure marker. WEAKNESSES: there is still no dated third-party evidence of trading - the only YellowPages review is from 05/17/2011, the site has no social links, no blog, no events, no online store (sitemap.ols.xml 404s) and no human-written text dated later than 'January 2026'; an earlier audit in this same repo rated this shop 'unknown / low confidence'. Yelp 403'd, and Google/Facebook/Foursquare/TripAdvisor/Reddit and every search engine were blocked to me. The open case therefore rests on a site republish 12 days ago plus a corroborated acquisition, not on anyone confirming the doors opened.

decisions.name: DD & Company, Inc. "Smokes Lounge"
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: No closure marker found anywhere, but I could not positively confirm current trading, and the site evidence the original claim leaned on does not hold up. dallascigars.co returns a real origin header Last-Modified: Thu, 13 Aug 2026, but that is a platform republish, not owner activity: the content behind it is frozen. /special-events still ends at '16 December 2022' (Perdomo Ugly Sweater), /products is untouched builder boilerplate ('Product 1 — Describe your product or give more information'), and the footer 'Follow us' block has no social links at all (href="" and href="#" only, no Facebook/Instagram to check). The 'Monday Pipe Night' cited as current evidence sits on that same frozen /weekly-events page with no dates attached, so it dates from the same 2022-era content. ddcigars.com is alive but only 302s to dallascigars.co, i.e. the domain is renewed, nothing more. That leaves the loc8nearme reviews (newest March 2026, ~6 months silent on a listing with 109 reviews) as the sole current signal, which is exactly the source I was asked to test rather than re-read; I found no independent corroboration on any other platform. Scope is not the problem here — it is a genuine cigar/pipe shop (owners Angel and Dave bought 'DD Cigars' in 2017, email info@ddcigars.com, pipe night, two lounges), so the only issue is liveness. Verification was hampered: this session's WebSearch budget was exhausted, and Yelp, Google, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Ecosia and searx all blocked or CAPTCHA'd both WebFetch and curl, while Bing returned degraded non-local results. Given the owner's rule that doubt favours dropping, a shop whose only current evidence is one scraper aggregator and whose own site has been content-dead for nearly four years should not be counted as confirmed open.

Wayback's CDX index does show the page digest changing (2025-04-28, 2025-06-15, 2026-05-19), but on a GoDaddy template that is consistent with platform boilerplate churn rather than owner edits, given the sitemap lastmod never moves off 2023-10-10. decisions.name: Wesmoke Cigars Shop
decisions.where: 205 E Wilson St, Villa Rica, GA, 30180
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: Two of the three pillars of the original claim are demonstrably wrong, and nothing independent replaces them. (1) 'Copyright (c) 2026 WeSmoke' is worthless: the raw HTML shows a GoDaddy Website Builder site (meta generator 'Go Daddy Website Builder 8.0.0000') whose footer node is literally data-aid="FOOTER_COPYRIGHT_RENDERED" — an auto-rendered current year. Proof: the Wayback capture of the identical page from 2023-11-01 reads 'Copyright (c) 2023 WeSmoke'. It tracks the clock, not the business. (2) The claim 'Aug 15 is a Saturday only in 2026, not 2024/2025' is false as stated — I computed weekdays 2015-2027 and Aug 15 = Saturday AND Sep 6 = Sunday holds identically in 2015 and 2020; only two years were excluded, not all. What genuinely does support 2026 is GoDaddy's server-generated sitemap.website.xml, <lastmod>2026-08-12</lastmod>, plus the fact that the Nov-2023 capture had different content (hours Mon-Tue 2-8pm, a 'September 15th Harley Davidson Bike Night' event), so the current events were authored after 2023. So the site was republished a month ago — but that is still one self-published page, and the remaining doubts are unresolved: ZERO third-party footprint (the repo's own Overture record, id f221340a-53cf-4c50-bfdd-c11f18f297fb, comes solely from source_dataset 'BrightQuery' — a registry/filings-derived set — with "socials": null and no Meta/Google/Yelp place record, unlike Maxwell's which has all three; the site's own 'Connect With Us!' heading carries no social links at all). Wayback has only 3 captures of the domain ever and none in 2026. Consequently there are no reviews anywhere I could reach, so the newest-review-date test could not be run at all — and every search engine (Google/Bing/DDG/Brave/Ecosia/Mojeek/SearxNG) plus Yelp and Facebook returned captcha/403, so the 'permanently closed marker' check was never actually performed for this listing. Softer negatives: the 'UPCOMING EVENTS' block contains only events already past (Aug 15, Sep 6) and the two dated ones are not even at the shop (a fraternity cookout in Palmetto GA and a jazz event in Fort Walton Beach FL, ~5 hours away); the only on-premises items are undated recurring ones, one still reading 'NFL Football (Returning September)' a week into the season; hours contracted since 2023 (Mon-Tue now CLOSED); and the page has no product content whatsoever — no brands, no humidor, no menu. Scope is probably fine (Overture category 'cigar_bar' at 0.99 confidence, self-describes as 'WeSmoke Cigars' / 'WeSmoke Cigar Shop'), so my objection is status, not scope. Given the burden of proof is on 'open' and doubt is a reason to drop, a lone GoDaddy page with a one-month-old republish, no reviews, no socials and no third-party record is unproven.

decisions.name: Maxwell's Cigar Bar
decisions.reason: Positively confirmed trading, on platform-generated timestamps rather than hand-typed text — which is the right test here, because the site's '(c) 2021' footer proves hand-typed strings on this site are stale. The Wix blog RSS at /blog-feed.xml carries server-generated <pubDate> values: the newest post is 'Live Music September 11-12, 2026 WOODSTOCK Georgia', published Thu, 10 Sep 2026 15:08:31 GMT — three days before today (13 Sep 2026). The feed shows an unbroken roughly-weekly cadence right through 2026 (04 Sep, 06 Aug, 29 Jul, 23 Jul, 16 Jul, 10 Jul, 04 Jul, 05 Jun, 30 Apr, 02 Apr, 20 Mar, 13 Mar, 05 Mar, 26 Feb, 20 Feb, 12 Feb, 06 Feb 2026), and the Wix-generated sitemap index independently reports lastmod 2026-09-10 for blog-posts-sitemap.xml. A CMS cannot back-date its own RSS pubDates the way a typist can mistype a year, so this is genuine evidence of an operator posting three days ago. IN SCOPE: the name is 'Maxwell's Cigar Bar'; the site sells 'fine cigars from all over the world' plus cutters, lighters, humidors, travel cases and pipe tobacco supplies, with beer and wine alongside — a cigar bar/lounge, which the owner's rule admits explicitly. Post titles reinforce it ('May 2026 - Live Music / Events / Cigars', 'April 2026 - Live Music / Events / Cigars'). It is not a vape/head/hookah/glass shop and not online-only: it is a physical room at 150 Towne Lake Pkwy STE 158, Woodstock GA, hours Mon-Thu 11am-10pm, Fri-Sat 11am-11pm, Sun 12-6pm. The repo's Overture record carries operating_status 'open' at 0.958 confidence with live Facebook, Instagram and Yelp links; its categories (cocktail_bar / lounge / music_venue) are a classifier quirk, not a scope disqualifier, since the trade being classified is a cigar bar. No closure marker found. Honest caveat: Yelp, Facebook and every search engine were 403/captcha-blocked, so I could not read third-party reviews or a closure flag directly — the confirmation rests on the 10 Sep 2026 Wix timestamps, not on third-party corroboration.

Chicago licence data shows the storefront is licensed under the DBA 'TOBACCO ON TAYLOR' (legal name RALPH'S CIGARS, INC.) at '1154 W TAYLOR ST 1ST' - I treated that as a possible 'general tobacco outlet' scope problem and checked it out rather than assuming. It holds up as a cigar shop: the catalogue I pulled myself is 250+ products at Regular Cigar 189, Merchandise/Hats 21, Cigar Accessories 20, Cognac Infused 17 - essentially all cigars; the About page describes a walk-in Chicago shop with knowledgeable staff and lounge-like ambiance ('the welcoming ambiance of Ralph's Cigars makes it the perfect place for connoisseurs and casual smokers alike to enjoy their cigars in comfort'); and the site's own legal notice states 'Our website does not sell cigarette, E-cigarettes, or vape.' 'Tobacco on Taylor' reads as a legacy registered trade name, not the trade. The licence itself is the strongest liveness evidence: active (AAI) Tobacco licence, current term 2026-05-16 to 2027-05-15, renewed annually since first issued 2018-08-07. Trading now: products.json newest published_at 2026-09-11 ('Game Day 2 Pack' - 'Game Day. Two Halves. Two Cigars.' - and 'Tailgate 6 Pack'), then 2026-09-03 and 2026-08-31; footer reads 'copyright 2026, Ralphs Cigars'; a live site-wide promo banner carries an expiry of 9/8/26. Physical location confirmed on the contact page fetched today: 1154 W Taylor St., Chicago, IL 60607, (312) 877-5755 / (312) 829-0672, store hours Mon-Sat 10 AM-7 PM, Sun 12 PM-5 PM - not online-only. One non-issue I checked and am flagging so nobody re-raises it: the same address shows 'ROSAL'S CUCINA' (a restaurant) on licences through 2018-05-15; that is the prior tenant Ralph's took over from in August 2018, not a different business occupying the address now.

decisions.name: Trading Post Tobacco and Cigars
decisions.reason: Could not refute; independently confirmed open and in scope. (1) OPEN — I re-queried Chicago open data myself, including the separate 'Business Licenses - CURRENT ACTIVE' dataset (uupf-x98q), not the history table the first researcher used. It returns exactly one live row today (2026-09-13): license_number 2698998, TRADING POST TOBACCO & CIGARS INC, 5510 W DEVON AVE 1, license_description 'Tobacco', application_requirements_complete 2025-09-15, payment_date 2025-10-31, date_issued 2025-11-03, term 2025-11-16 to 2026-11-15, status AAI, ward 45, Forest Glen/Sauganash. A renewal the owner paid for in Oct 2025 and the city's current-active feed still carries today. (2) NOT REPLACED — I pulled the full licence history filtered by ADDRESS rather than by name (r5kz-chrr, upper(address) like '%5510 W DEVON%'): every one of the 18 records from 2002 to 2026 is Trading Post, an unbroken renewal chain with no gap and no other business ever licensed at that address. So the address is not now hosting someone else. (3) NO CLOSURE MARKER — YellowPages carries a live listing (yellowpages.com/chicago-il/mip/trading-post-tobacco-cigars-17792779) with hours Mon-Sun 10:00-18:00 and NO 'CLOSED' flag; YP does flag closures and did so for other shops in the same result set ('Park Ridge Cigar Lounge - CLOSED', 'Karma Tobacco & Cigar Lounge - CLOSED'), so the absence is meaningful rather than a coverage gap. (4) IN SCOPE — the site is a straight tobacconist, not a smoke/vape/head shop: nav is La Hoja De Rosalia / Panama Hats / Humidors / Accessories / Shop / Gallery / Events, About Us reads 'Our Cigar shop has been open for 50 years serving the Chicagoland area', the Events page reads 'CIGAR SMOKING LOUNGE - 50 years of providing a friendly, relaxed atmosphere to enjoy a premium smoke' and offers custom-made cigars for weddings; two house Nicaraguan brands (La Hoja De Rosalia Entombed/Entubar, Trading Post). No vape, glass, hookah, CBD or cigarette-counter merchandising anywhere on the site. CAVEATS the owner should know: (a) the live homepage text is byte-identical to the Wayback capture of 2026-02-07, so the site has not been touched in ~7 months and its '© 2026' is an auto-updating GoDaddy footer, i.e. the site is not itself fresh evidence — the licence is; (b) YP shows zero reviews ('Be the first to review!') so there is no review-recency signal; (c) this session's web-search budget was exhausted and Google, Yelp, Foursquare, Bing local, DuckDuckGo, Brave, Startpage and Reddit all blocked or returned junk, so I could not check for a Google/Yelp 'Permanently closed' badge. I found no evidence of closure, only an inability to check those two specific surfaces.

decisions.name: The Embassy Cigar Lounge
decisions.reason: Could not refute; I closed the first researcher's 'all first-party, no third-party confirmation' gap with live third-party booking data. THE SITE IS https://www.theembassy.vip/ (1615 Vollmer Rd, Flossmoor IL 60422). (1) TRADING NOW, THIRD-PARTY HOSTED — the site's reservation link points at SevenRooms, a paid commercial booking platform. I queried SevenRooms' own availability API directly (api-yoa/availability/widget/range, venue=theembassycigarlounge, channel=SEVENROOMS_WIDGET) for five separate future dates today, 2026-09-13, and every one returned live public bookable inventory with is_closed=false: Mon 2026-09-14 shift 'Day Mon-Thu' 29 slots 15:00-22:00; Tue 09-15 same; Fri 09-18 shift 'Day Fri' 33 slots 15:00-23:00; Sun 09-20 29 slots; Sat 09-26 shift 'Day Sat' 33 slots 15:00-23:00. Slot type 'book', description 'Public'. These are per-weekday named shifts whose windows match the hours published on /visitus (Mon-Thu 3-10pm, Fri 3-11pm) — that is an actively maintained, staffed booking configuration on someone else's servers, not a static web page. A closed venue does not keep 29-33 public seats open for tomorrow and for two weeks out. (2) RECENTLY MAINTAINED — Wix page-revision metadata in the served HTML shows updatedDate 2026-05-20; the Journal has posts with firstPublishedDate 2026-02-23 and 2026-08-04 (the latter ~5 weeks ago, 'a Black owned cigar lounge in Chicago's Southland'); Wayback shows the homepage digest changing at every capture through 2026-06-11. (3) IN SCOPE as a cigar lounge, and the bar really is ancillary: the home page describes 6,400 sq ft split into 'the public lounge — Bar . Walk In Humidor . Conference Room . Golf Sim' and 'the members lounge — Private Rooms . Member Storage . Living Room Seating'. Cigar memberships, member cigar storage, house cigar blends and an annual house release. Schema.org types on the page are 'The Embassy Cigar Collection' / 'The Embassy Cigar Lounge'. No hookah/shisha, no vape, no glass, no CBD anywhere on the site. CAVEATS worth recording: (a) the /visitus FAQ literally says 'It is not a tobacconist. Not a club.' — they mean they position as a lounge rather than a retail shop, which is still inside the owner's rule ('cigar shop, cigar lounge, or tobacconist'), but if the owner wants over-the-counter retail specifically, this is the one line that argues against; (b) the nightlife programming is real — 'Mezcal mondays', 'afro beat saturdays', a 'curated spirits program', private events and a golf sim — so it is a hospitality venue built around cigars rather than a shop with chairs; (c) the site markets seven locations (Flossmoor IL, Park Ridge IL, Michigan City IN, Las Vegas NV, Scottsdale AZ, Fort Lauderdale FL, Alpharetta GA), all but Flossmoor 'Coming Soon' — expansion-marketing flavour, though Flossmoor is consistently described as 'the original' and is the one with hours, a phone and live bookings; (d) two different phone numbers appear on the site ((708) 627-2252 in JSON-LD vs (708) 734-6521 on /visitus); (e) still no consumer-review corroboration — the venue is absent from YellowPages entirely, and Google, Yelp, Foursquare and all search engines were blocked or exhausted this session, so I could not check for a 'Permanently closed' badge or newest-review date. The SevenRooms inventory is the load-bearing third-party evidence and it is dated today.

decisions.name: Hickey Brothers Cigar Store
decisions.reason: on a second look: Explicit closure marker. QuadCities.com, published 21 November 2020, quotes the business: "This will be Hickey Bros. Cigars and Hookah Lounge's final weekend. We will be closed permanently after this Saturday the 21st." The Quad-City Times ran a matching piece, "With Hickey Brothers in downtown Rock Island shutting down, door closes on potential of indoor cannabis smoking lounge in Q-C". Yelp's page is titled "HICKEY BROTHERS - CLOSED - Updated December 2025". It traded 23 years and was killed by COVID restrictions after a November 2020 fundraiser fell short. This is exactly the trap the first pass suspected: hickeybrothers.com is still live and still posts full weekly hours, but the site has been stale for nearly six years. Nothing dated after November 2020 exists anywhere. Note for scope: it sold premium cigars first but also hookahs, shisha and vape pens, so it was a mixed cigar/hookah business.

decisions.name: The Cigar Box
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED ON THE ADDRESS. The company trades, but this listing's premises is announced vacated in 4 days with no successor address published anywhere. The home page banner reads verbatim: 'The Carmel Store is Relocating! / THURSDAY, SEPTEMBER 17th / Join us at our Westfield location until the new store opens.' - i.e. the Carmel unit stops trading on 17 Sep 2026 and customers are redirected to a different town in the interim, with an open-ended gap. A FINDING THE ORIGINAL RESEARCHER MISSED, which removes their main proof: every future-dated event they cited as evidence this address is alive (Live Music Sep 17, Sep 24, Oct 1, Oct 8, Oct 23) is staged at '1385 Chatham Commons Blvd' - the WESTFIELD lounge - not at Carmel. None of those events evidences 13702 N Meridian St at all. I also enumerated every street address string on the whole site: only three exist (13702 N Meridian, 7421 N Shadeland, 1385 Chatham Commons), and a grep for 'new store / new location / coming soon / opening' returns only the banner itself - no replacement Carmel address is published. The Indiana ATC cert TC11141002 at exactly '13702 N. Meridian St', Carmel IN 46032 is still ACTIVE (renewed 7 Nov 2025, expires 5 Dec 2028), but a tobacco certificate runs its full term whether or not the licensee vacates the unit, so it is not evidence of occupancy after the 17th. Given the owner would rather drop a good shop than keep a dead one, a listing whose address expires this week with nothing to re-point it to should be dropped now rather than re-verified later. If it is kept instead, re-point it to the Westfield premises at 1385 Chatham Commons Blvd, Westfield IN 46074, where 'The Cigar Box, LLC' holds ACTIVE cert TC17688001 and 'The Cigar Box, LLP' holds ACTIVE alcohol permit RR2941663.

decisions.name: Miller Beach Cigar Bar
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED ON SCOPE (it is open, but its primary trade is not cigars). Openness is not in doubt: Dialogue, LLC holds ACTIVE Retail Tobacco Sales Location cert TC15774001 at exactly '567 S. Lake Street', Gary IN 46403 (renewed 3 Mar 2025, expires 14 Mar 2028), and DIALOGUE LLC's alcohol permit RR4538645 was RENEWED 20 AUG 2026 - three weeks ago. The problem is what the business actually is. (1) The state's registered DBA on that alcohol permit is 'DIALOGUE WINE BAR & MILLER BEACH CIGAR BAR' on a single premises recorded as '567-601 S LAKE STREET' - the cigar bar shares one licence and one address with the owners' wine bar, and the wine bar is named first. Permit type is 'Beer Wine & Liquor - Restaurant (210)'. (2) Decisive: I pulled the venue's own complete price list at millerbeachcigarbar.com/list, headed 'Our Full Menu'. It contains ZERO cigars. Every item is drink - 'Premium Dark Liquor' (Jameson, Hennessy, Crown Royal...), 'HANDCRAFTED COCKTAILS', 'Premium Light Liquor', 'Gin and Vodka'. No humidor, no cigar brand, no cigar price anywhere on the site; /shop is an empty page. (3) The About page: owners Greg and Monica Tatum describe themselves as owners of 'Dialogue Wine Bar the first black owned wine bar in Gary' who 'expand[ed]'; the only content section beneath is 'We Provide the Soundtrack!' listing eight DJ credits. (4) Programming and hours are nightlife, not retail - events are 'First Friday w/ DJ Rob La Roc', 'Ladies Night w/ Cheech Beats', 'The Virgo Bash'; hours are Thu-Sun evenings only (Thu 7pm-12am, Fri/Sat 8pm-1am, Sun 5pm-10pm), closed Mon-Wed. (5) The site is a lightly-maintained GoDaddy template - unfilled placeholders 'Add a description about this category' / 'Add a description about this item' / 'Add a footnote if this applies to your business' survive in the live menu, and 'Signed in as: filler@godaddy.com' is left in the markup. This reads as a wine bar / DJ venue that permits smoking and carries a tobacco cert, not a tobacconist or cigar-led lounge. Under the owner's strict rule that primary trade must be cigars or pipe tobacco, this is a 'no' on the same logic as the Mary Jane's rejection.

decisions.name: Burn by Rocky Patel Indianapolis
decisions.reason: Could not refute - confirmed trading and in scope. Indiana ATC/MyLicense holds Retail Tobacco Sales Location cert TC13217001, DBA 'Burn by Rocky Patel', licensee Indianapolis Burn LLC, status ACTIVE and RENEWED 29 JUN 2026 (about 10 weeks ago), expires 30 Aug 2029. Same licensee holds ACTIVE alcohol permit RR4932859, DBA 'BURN BY ROCKY PATEL', type 'Beer Wine & Liquor - Civic, Mall, Market'. A renewal filed in June 2026 is strong proof of current trading. Scope is fine and it is not a brand-only office: the Indianapolis page describes a Spanish-cedar walk-in humidor of 'over 400 premium hand-rolled cigars', and I independently checked the chain's own home page, which lists Indianapolis among its five operating lounges (Naples, Indianapolis, Atlanta, Pittsburgh, Oklahoma City) - so the brand has not dropped this location. Phone on the site, (317) 602 2260, matches the listing. TWO CAVEATS TO PASS ON, neither sufficient to refute: (a) the separate Indiana 'Cigar Sales Certificate' CC13217001 for this licensee EXPIRED 30 Aug 2026 and has not been renewed - the core retail tobacco licence is the Active one, but this is worth a re-check later; (b) the address discrepancy resolves in the LISTING's favour, not the site's - the state records the premises as '49 West Maryland Street, Suite C-30B, Indianapolis IN 46204' (Circle Centre Mall, consistent with the 'Civic, Mall, Market' permit type), while the Census geocoder returns '110 S MERIDIAN ST, INDIANAPOLIS, IN, 46225'. Same mall block, two address conventions; the listing's ZIP 46225 is correct for 110 S Meridian St and should NOT be changed to the 46204 the site prints.

(3) I could not independently corroborate the Facebook page that is the sole current signal: curl on facebook.com/HavanaShreveport returned HTTP 400, and WebFetch on both the www and m. variants returned only a browser-compatibility error page with no post, no date and no category. The epoch arithmetic checks out in the abstract (1788807780 = 2026-09-07 19:03 UTC, and US Labor Day 2026 was indeed Monday 7 Sept) but I have no way to confirm the post exists, so the whole 'open' case rests on a single unreplicated observation. Combined with the Google review the first researcher quoted noting 'there's an entire cigar shop right next door' (M.A.'s), the primary trade reads as a bar, not a cigar retailer. Doubt on freshness plus doubt on scope - drop it.

For 33rd Street there is none: every 2026 event on senorcigars.com is at the 118th Street shop (including the Sept 17 2026 Oliva event the researcher cited, at 11805 Coastal Hwy), the newest third-party review visible is October 2025, and the newest site item naming 33rd Street is the Oct 28 2025 'closed for staff training' post. decisions.name: Churchills Bistro Cigar Bar
decisions.where: 116 S Old Woodward Ave, Birmingham, MI, 48009
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED ON SCOPE, not on liveness. To be clear about what I did confirm: it IS trading. The Birmingham Shopping District - the official downtown business district, which maintains a current member directory and a separate space-available list - has a live page for "Churchill's, 116 South Old Woodward Avenue, Birmingham, MI 48009, (248) 647-4555", and 116 S Old Woodward does not appear on its space-available list. YellowPages also shows it "open now". So it is not dead. But the primary-trade test fails, and the site owner's rule is strict. (1) The downtown district files it under DINE, not Shops, with categories "American and European, Bars and Nightlife, Patios & Outdoor Dining, Happy Hour" - the official local directory does not give it a cigar or tobacco category at all. (2) Overture/Meta classifies it taxonomy_primary "steakhouse", basic_category "restaurant", alt_categories seafood_restaurant / restaurant. (3) Its own site leads with food on every surface: "Churchill's Bistro & Cigar Bar - Elevating the Dining Experience with Exceptional Steaks, Fresh Seafood, and the Finest Cigars in the Heart of Birmingham", "A Unique Dining Experience", "a popular dining spot known for its excellent menu and outstanding service", "a full menu bistro". The Birmingham promos are "25% off wine on Mondays", "Happy Hour Daily Noon-6pm", "Sunday & Monday all bottles of wine 25% off", with cigars one line among them and the note "All promotions are dine-in only". (4) The operator itself draws the distinction: this is a five-location chain, and the site labels Birmingham and Grosse Pointe Woods "Bistro + Cigar Bar" while labelling Rochester Hills and West Bloomfield plain "Cigar Bar". By their own taxonomy the Birmingham room is the bistro-first one. That is a steakhouse that also runs a humidor, which sits closer to the excluded categories than to a tobacconist, and the other researcher already conceded scope was "genuinely arguable" at medium confidence. With the burden on "in scope" and doubt counting against, this is a drop. Minor staleness notes that support the same call: site footer still says "(c) 2025" and the Birmingham events block is an empty "Coming Soon!". If the owner wants a Churchill's in the directory, the Rochester Hills (2596 S Rochester Rd) or West Bloomfield (6635 Orchard Lake Rd) rooms are the ones the operator calls plain cigar bars.

I fetched the Restaurant Guru page for Le Cigar Dearborn today. Cigar and drink selection are vast"). That is customer traffic in mid-August 2026, about four weeks before today. An 8-month-old review describes trying to buy Liga Privada No. 9 Flying Pigs and being handed Feral Flying Pigs instead - people transacting over boutique premium cigars, which is as good a scope proof as exists. Own site is live with (c) 2026: "a Davidoff appointed merchant", "the best kept walk-in humidor in Michigan", a humidor list running Davidoff, Padron, Opus X, Ashton, AVO, My Father, Diamond Crown, Paul Garmirian, plus humidors, cutters, cases and lighters; hours Mon-Sun 12 p.m.-2 a.m.; phone (313) 359-1716 matching every source. YellowPages files it under "Cigar, Cigarette & Tobacco Dealers | Pipes & Smokers Articles", open now, same phone. No vape, glass, CBD or convenience offer. TWO CORRECTIONS FOR THE RECORD. (1) ADDRESS - I reconciled it, and 21918 Michigan Ave is right. Le Cigar's own contact page and Restaurant Guru both say 21918, and the OSM lat/lng already on the listing (42.3067/-83.2432) matches 21918. The competing 22263 Michigan Ave came from a Microsoft-sourced Overture record and is wrong: YellowPages currently shows ROBUSTO'S CIGAR BAR & BISTRO, (313) 998-8488, at 22263 Michigan Ave, Dearborn - a different business, 8 years in business. So 22263 is a stale address that has since been taken by someone else, and any duplicate record on it should be dropped rather than merged. (2) HOOKAH - it does surface. Restaurant Guru's "frequently mentioned in reviews" tags lead with "hookah", and a YellowPages review mentions "great hoockah and cigar" (though that one dates to 2007). I still read cigars as the primary trade given the name, the Davidoff appointment, the walk-in humidor and the boutique-cigar purchase reviews - but flagging it so the owner can overrule me if he wants a harder line on hookah.

decisions.name: City Cigar Co
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED as unproven (no closure marker found, but 'open' is not carried). Note first: I DISPROVED the argument a previous pass used here, so this verdict rests on new grounds. That pass said Squarespace 'contentModified'=1740517316526 (2025-02-25) proves the homepage content never changed since build day. That field is frozen dead on this site: I pulled the Wayback capture of 2025-03-17 (web.archive.org/web/20250317170658id_/) and it carries the IDENTICAL contentModifiedOn stamp, yet its content differs from today's - the Rea Rd phone then was (704) 543-1411 vs (704) 443-7203 now, Huntersville had no phone, and the 'Now Open!' graphic was absent. So content demonstrably changed while that stamp stood still. Likewise 'collection.updatedOn'=2026-07-03 is probably a REAL page edit, not a platform bump: I ran a control over six other Squarespace cigar sites and the field scatters (thecigardistrict 2015-09-15, stogies 2020-01-30, cjscigars 2025-05-21, sanctuary 2026-04-07, stixx 2026-07-22, estatecigars 2026-07-27), which a bulk regeneration could not produce. WHY IT STILL FAILS: everything above is platform metadata; none of it is evidence about the 9815 Rea Rd storefront. (1) New hard evidence I derived: the Squarespace CDN serves Google-Cloud-Storage ETags whose generation is microseconds-since-epoch, so I decoded upload times for all four homepage images - DSC_0805.JPG 2025-02-25T21:30Z, unsplash 2025-02-25T20:42Z, Untitled(Website)2.png 2025-02-25T20:58Z, 'Now Open!.png' 2025-05-09T18:09Z. Method validated: the unsplash file's own Squarespace filename prefix 1740516151340 = 2025-02-25T20:42:31.340Z, agreeing with the decoded generation to 1.4 seconds. So the newest asset ever added to the site is 9 May 2025, 16 months ago. (2) The site is ONE page - sitemap.xml holds only /home, and /shop /store /events /about /contact /blog /locations all 404 - so there is no recency channel at all. (3) 'Now Open!' sits in the DOM immediately after the Northcross/Huntersville block (offset 1221796 vs 1215908) and its May-2025 upload matches the Huntersville opening, so it is not a badge for Rea Rd. (4) The only press anywhere is Lake Norman Publications, 30 Jul 2025 - 14 months old, headlined 'Huntersville cigar shop'. I fetched it: useful context (Rea Rd opened 2010; Huntersville is the McCranie family's FOURTH shop), which cuts AGAINST a consolidation theory, but it is still 2025 evidence about a sibling store. Google News RSS on '"City Cigar Co"', '"City Cigar" Charlotte', 'Huntersville cigar McCranie' and 'Charlotte NC cigar shop opens Blakeney' surfaces nothing else and nothing since. (5) I tried to corroborate via the family's other site: mccranies.com IS alive (WooCommerce products edited 2026-09-13, 09-12, 09-11, 09-10 at irregular human hours; media 2026-09-03), and its footer does list CITY CIGAR CO., Blakeney Crossing, 9815 Rea Road - but that footer is provably frozen: it is byte-identical to the 2026-06-16 Wayback capture, still carries the SUPERSEDED phone 704.543.1411, and omits the Huntersville shop that opened in summer 2025. So it cannot corroborate 2026 trading. Scope is impeccable and not the issue (McCranie family tobacconists, premium cigars, zero vape/glass/hookah). Bottom line: a 15-year-old store in a demonstrably live family group, with no closure marker - but the newest thing tying the Rea Rd unit to 2026 is an opaque platform stamp, and no third-party source was reachable (Yelp 403, Google JS-only, Bing's index returned results about Gilbert AZ, Facebook 400, Instagram login wall, BBB has no such listing). Burden on 'open' not met.

decisions.name: Smoking Bull Cigar Lounge
decisions.reason: POSITIVELY CONFIRMED trading and in scope. Open-ness, from the WordPress REST API (authoritative server-side timestamps, not sitemap or platform stamps): /wp/v2/media shows a CONTINUOUS cadence of human uploads with descriptive, human-authored titles through the summer - 2026-06-03 'jul and bud', 06-09 'knockout monday' and 'well men wednesday', 06-17 'Cuts and Karaoke' and 'Bigg Ricc', 06-30 '4th bash', 07-01 'Cut and Light', 07-04 'DJ Heavy Day and Block Party' (+2), 07-07 'Bigg Riccj24', 08-01 'First Leo Friday', 08-08 'jazz patio' and 'its a leo thing', and 08-15T08:02:13 'R&B on Patio'. Newest is four weeks before today (2026-09-13). These are event flyers, not platform artifacts. Internal consistency check that rules out back-dating or carry-over: 'First Leo Friday' was uploaded 2026-08-01 and Leo season runs 23 Jul-22 Aug, so the flyer is contemporaneous with its own upload date. Second independent signal: /wp/v2/pages shows the events page modified 2026-08-15T08:06:01 while EVERY other page sits at 2024-2025 (shop 2025-04-23, policies 2025-03-25, checkout 2025-03-23, cigar-shop 2025-02-18, my-account 2024-09-21, cart 2024-08-31). A single page moving alone is a targeted human edit - the exact opposite of the Casablanca case in this batch, where all 16 pages shared one identical stamp. Third: live catalogue maintenance - 16 products edited in one session on 2026-06-16 (LFD Solis, LFD Capitulo II, CAO BX3, Joya, Don Pepin Blue Lancero, My Father The Judge, Alec Bradley Gatekeeper, Foundation Wise Man Maduro and others) plus perdomo-10th-anniversary-champagne-2 on 2026-08-08. SCOPE, checked hard because the name and the DJ/karaoke programming invited doubt: I pulled all 314 products - 313 are premium cigars (Perdomo, La Flor Dominicana, CAO, Joya, Don Pepin, My Father, Alec Bradley, Foundation, Plasencia, Rocky Patel, Oliva Melanio, Nub, Montecristo, Trinidad, Macanudo, Tatiana, ACID/Java). Category counts: Cigars 41, memberships 3, everything else zero. There is exactly ONE hookah SKU ('Hookah', created 2025-03, uncategorised) - a side item on a lounge menu, analogous to the owner's 'cigarettes on the side is fine' allowance, not a hookah lounge. I checked and cleared two apparent red flags: the strings 'Bong' and 'cbd' on the events page are a Liberian county in a WooCommerce country/state list and the CSS element id 'c6a7cbd' respectively. No vape, glass, kratom, delta-8 or CBD products exist. Self-describes as '#1 Smoking lounge in Bull city' offering 'premium cigars'; runs paid memberships (ywsbs_subscription plugin + 3 'Bull Memberships' SKUs). Cigar lounge with a premium-cigar catalogue as its trade: in scope. HONEST CAVEAT: zero site activity since 2026-08-15 - I queried product/pages/media with modified_after=2026-09-01 and all returned X-WP-Total 0 - so there is a four-week gap after a roughly twice-weekly cadence. Four weeks is well short of a staleness signal, but it is the one soft spot. No third-party review data was obtainable (Yelp 403, Facebook/Instagram walled, Google News RSS has nothing on this business).

decisions.name: Casablanca Cigar Bar
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED for THIS LOCATION. Both of the original researcher's signals are artifacts, verified independently. (1) The 'maintained events calendar carrying future dates' is a Wix recurrence artifact. I pulled event-pages-sitemap.xml: 143 event pages, 47 distinct slug dates, and the forward-dated ones form a perfect monthly series - 2026-06-04, 07-02, 08-06, 09-03, 10-01, 11-05, 12-03, 2027-01-07, 02-04, 03-04, 04-01, 05-06, 06-03, 07-01, 08-05, 09-02, 10-07, 11-04, 12-02, 2028-01-06 out to 2028-05-04 - i.e. auto-generated first-Thursday instances of Toby's Briar Pipe Society. 29 of them share one bulk lastmod, 2026-05-25. Nobody scheduled anything into 2028. (2) The 'pages-sitemap lastmod 2026-07-02' is worthless: I pulled all 16 entries (home, about, store, locations, events, press, contact-us, privacy-policy, cigars-pipes, the-list, past-events, special-events, cigar-101-class, meet-sam-brooke, lead-collection, inquiry-services-page) and every one carries the byte-identical 2026-07-02 - a platform-wide regeneration. (3) The caveat the original researcher recorded but did not act on is fatal and I reproduced it today: the live /events page renders 'No events at the moment'. For a venue whose top-level nav is events and which historically ran 143 of them, an empty calendar in mid-September is a decay signal, not maintenance. (4) Genuine human content stops: blog-posts-sitemap has 5 posts ending 2026-02-23 (Perdomo), nothing in ~7 months. The newest datable human edit I could find anywhere on the marketing site is buried in the Wix payload - an 'Event Contact Form' created 2026-05-12 and updated 2026-05-18. The footer still reads 'Casablanca Cigar Bar (c) 2024', and /locations still says 'As we work to rebuild our Biltmore Village location' nearly two years after Helene. I checked the '2026-09-10' string in the homepage and it is a per-request Wix JWT signDate, not content. (5) No third-party coverage since Cigar Aficionado 15 Oct 2024; Google News RSS on 'Casablanca Cigar Hendersonville' and 'Hendersonville NC cigar bar closed' returns only Helene-era Asheville items. COUNTERWEIGHT I FOUND AND AM RECORDING HONESTLY, because it nearly flipped me: store.casablancacigarbar.com is a live WooCommerce with 378 products, and it is transacting RIGHT NOW - 70 products modified today (2026-09-13, staggered 14:53-16:06 UTC) and 200 in the last 7 days, a partial rolling pattern consistent with POS stock sync rather than a nightly sweep; the /sale page was edited 2026-09-01 and its footer reads 'Copyright 2026'. So the COMPANY is unquestionably trading. WHY THAT DOES NOT SAVE THE LISTING: this record is the Hendersonville lounge at 411 N Main St, and Casablanca is multi-site (Biltmore Village closed and rebuilding, a Wall Street Market 'satellite humidor' in Asheville, Hendersonville). I looked for anything tying the live store to this address and found none - store.casablancacigarbar.com has no contact, about, locations, store-locator or pickup page (all 404) and no address or 828 number anywhere in its markup. Company-level commerce does not confirm this storefront, and the location-specific evidence stops in May 2026 with an empty calendar and a dead blog. Scope is fine and not the issue (largest humidor in WNC, Toby's Briar Pipe Society, 'does not sell cigarettes, smokeless tobacco or roll-your-own'). No review dates or CLOSED markers were obtainable (Yelp 403, Google JS-only, Facebook/Instagram walled). Doubt about this specific address stands.

The Oct 29 listing puts the venue at "804 North Main Street, High Point, NC 27262" and describes "cocktails, cigars, music and grown energy in an intimate lounge setting", and ashandbarrelnc.com confirms "804 N MAIN HIGH POINT NC 27465", "Crafted for the modern cigar enthusiast", with membership tiers including "1 House Cigar Each Month". Meanwhile the Southerlands brand is dormant, not relocated: southerlandscigarlounge.com still advertises the same 804 N Main address with no move notice, its sitemap stopped at 2026-02-10, and its footer still reads "© 2021 Southerlands Cigar Lounge" with an empty "Upcoming Events" section. Note for the record: the first pass got HTTP 403 here because the site blocks that agent in robots.txt — it is readable with an ordinary browser user agent, which is how I retrieved the above. Recommend relisting the address under Ash & Barrel.

decisions.name: Abbies Cigars
decisions.reason: POSITIVELY CONFIRMED trading and in scope, on three independent dated signals. (1) FUTURE-DATED EVENT, verified arithmetically rather than taken on trust. The live /events page carries exactly one event: 'National Coffee Day / Tuesday September 29th / 11:00 AM - 09:00 PM / Sit back, relax and enjoy a coffee for National Coffee Day September 29th!'. I computed the weekday of 29 September for 2023-2029: Fri, Sun, Mon, TUE, Wed, Fri, Sat. It is trading — its Facebook page (facebook.com/p/TKS-Cigar-Bar-and-Golf-Sims-61583964269304/) shows "Open now" and a post 6 days before the audit ("Happy labor day weekend"). But cigars are not demonstrably the PRIMARY trade. Facebook's own category line for the business is "Lounge · Indoor Golf Course · Sports & recreation" — no tobacco, cigar-store or tobacconist category at all. TripAdvisor files it as "#1 of 1 Nightlife in Center Ossipee", i.e. a nightlife venue, not a shop. Its own /tee-times page sells TrackMan simulator bays at $60/hour (2 bays, 60-minute minimum, max 4 per bay) and a full cocktail/whiskey bar, and states "There is absolutely NO SMOKING in our simulator barn" — the golf half is a physically separate, 100% smoke-free building, so it is a co-equal (and separately monetised) business rather than an amenity of a cigar shop. The site itself also says "As a cigar bar, we do not serve food", and the homepage leads with "Our Golf Simulators Are 100% Smoke-Free" and a "Book a Tee Time" CTA. Its "Cigar Selection" page is only a list of brands "we carry or have carried", with the disclaimer that the pictured cigars "may not be in stock at the time of your visit" — no retail catalogue. Add that it is brand new (venue created 2025-12-04, only ~7 Facebook reviews and zero TripAdvisor reviews) and there is credible doubt on both the primary-trade test and on durability. Burden of proof is on "in scope"; it is not met.

decisions.name: Federal Cigar
decisions.reason: Could not refute — independently confirmed open and in scope. Federal Cigar's own Epping store page (federalcigar.com/epping-nh-store/, fetched 2026-09-13) gives 96 Calef Highway, phone 603-679-2447 and hours 11am-7pm; the Events page fetched the same day states events are hosted at "our Portsmouth, Dover and Epping locations" with a future-dated Dover Poker Night (Sep 24 - Dec 10, 2026). Independent of the shop's own site: cigarlounges.co carries a live Epping listing showing 4.2 stars from 68 Google reviews with daily 11AM-7PM hours and the same 603-679-2447 number (a genuine Epping exchange), and the Yelp page www.yelp.com/biz/federal-cigar-epping is live and titled "Updated July 2026". No CLOSED / permanently-closed marker appeared on Yelp, MapQuest, YellowPages, Loc8NearMe, Cigar Trader, CigarDig or any other directory I checked, and no news/forum post about a closure. The odd-looking "#2224" in the listing address is the ZIP+4 (03042-2224), not a phantom suite — 96 Calef Hwy is a real multi-tenant retail centre ("Eppicenter", also Core Physicians, Supercuts), so the address is not hosting a different business in place of the shop. Scope is clean: a premium cigar retailer/tobacconist est. 1921, no vape/head/hookah/CBD character. Weakest point (not enough to refute): I could not date the newest Google review directly, and the chain's own store-locations page says Epping is "Retail shop — no lounge" while its Epping page still describes the members-only Culebra Club there — a stale-copy inconsistency, not a closure signal.

decisions.name: Holy Smokes
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED on scope. It is open, but it is a craft-beer-plus-smoke/vape/CBD/kratom retailer, which the owner's rule excludes "however many cigars they happen to stock". The same business at 297 S Willow St runs a second site, holysmokesnh.com, whose meta description reads: "Holy Smokes NH offers a variety of craft beers, CBD products, kratom, disposable vapes, and premium cigars in Manchester, NH", and whose schema.org Organization name is literally "Holy Smokes NH - CBD Oil". I verified live today (2026-09-13) that holysmokesnh.com/product-category/kratom/ returns HTTP 200 with a full "Kratom Store Holy Smokes in Manchester, NH" sales page ("Kratom Red Vein - Kratom Powders - Kratom Shots - Kratom Capsules"), and that its product_cat-sitemap.xml is dominated by CBD categories (all-cbd-products, cbd-for-recovery, strong-cbd-products, natures-pure-cbd tinctures/oils) with no cigar category at all. holysmokescigars.com merchandises EFX nicotine pouches on the homepage. Third parties classify it the same way: Yandex Maps lists it as "Vape shop Holy Smokes"; getcbdstore.com lists it as "Holy Smokes Vapes & Cigars — a CBD shop in Manchester"; kratom vendor directories (kratomplants.org, newdawnkratom.com) describe it as combining craft beer with "premium kratom, CBD, and vaping products" and "a wide selection of Delta 8, vape juice, and other smoking accessories"; LocalityBiz files it as a Liquor Store; cannabispromotions.com calls it a smoke shop. Its Google Business Profile name leads with the beer, not the cigars: "Craft Beer Store - Holy Smokes Cigars", and the operation runs a dedicated beer storefront at craftbeernh.com. A good walk-in humidor does not rescue it — this is the "Mary Jane's House of Glass" pattern with beer and kratom instead of glass.

decisions.name: Nh Cigars
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED on two independent grounds. (1) THE LISTED ADDRESS IS ANOTHER BUSINESS'S STOREFRONT. 297 South Willow St, Manchester NH is occupied by 'Holy Smokes' (holysmokescigars.com) -- OSM way w150812669 'Holy Smokes, 297 South Willow Street, Manchester, NH 03103', shop=tobacco, and Overture/Meta carries 'Holy Smokes, 297 S Willow St' at confidence 0.9997, the highest-confidence tobacco record in the whole Manchester NH set. This project's own osm_stores.json already classifies it store_type=smoke_shop. Nominatim's other mapped tenants at 297 S Willow are 'Cash 4 Gold' (shop=jewelry) and 'Liberty Tax' (office=tax_advisor). A Nominatim name search for 'NH Cigars Manchester New Hampshire' returns an empty array -- OSM maps no NH Cigars anywhere, although it maps Federal Cigar's three NH shops. The ONLY place record for NH Cigars is Overture id 610643dd-fe44-4908-8670-5d9599d76cb2, source_dataset 'BrightQuery' (a business-registration/credit data vendor, i.e. the LLC's registered address, not an observed place), category 'cigar_bar', confidence 0.75. (2) IT IS AN ONLINE-ONLY SELLER, which the owner's rule excludes. The about page's <title> is literally 'About Us - Best Online Cigar Store - NH Cigars'; the homepage headline is 'Best Tax Free Cigar Store Online'; the about-page history says they opened a store in Manchester in 2004 and then 'Recognizing the rise of eCommerce, Mike and Robert pivoted their focus to online sales', and today 'ships millions of cigars annually'. The page sitemap (61 URLs) has no locations/visit/store page at all; the nav is Track Order / Shipping & Delivery / Returns; /contact-us/ is a CUSTOMER SERVICE block that tells you to 'leave your order ID # in the message', with a toll-free 1.888.302.4427 order line and a Canada line as the only phones -- no directions, no store photo, no 'visit us'. (3) The storefront hours are self-contradictory boilerplate: /contact-us/ visible text says 11am-8pm Mon-Sat, Sun 11am-6pm; the same page's JSON-LD says 'Mo,Tu,We,Th,Fr,Sa 10:00-19:00','Su 11:00-18:00' (and types the entity only as 'Place'/'ContactPage', not LocalBusiness/Store); /about-us/ says 'Store Front & Customer Service Hours of Ops (11am-7pm Mon-Sat) - (Sunday 11am-5pm)'; the footer says 'LIVE HELP 11AM - 7PM ( DAILY )'. Four mutually incompatible hour sets. The other researcher's sitemap-lastmod evidence proves only that a live e-commerce site is being maintained, which nobody disputes -- it says nothing about a walk-in cigar shop, and the researcher conceded there was no third-party confirmation. There still is none, and the address belongs to a smoke shop.
