Squarespace's own JSON feed (theexecutiveleaf.com/store?format=json-pretty) gives each item's real updatedOn: Corporate Membership Monthly 2026-08-28T08:28:35.607Z, Corporate Annual 08:28:50.971Z, Executive VIP Annual 08:28:59.218Z, Executive VIP Monthly 08:29:00.431Z, VIP Monthly 08:29:00.871Z, VIP Annual 08:29:01.379Z. All six inside 26 seconds of one another -- a single batch operation. The other researcher read the sitemap's date-only stamps, saw '2026-08-28' six times plus '2026-09-01' once, and concluded they were 'genuine edits, not a blanket regeneration'; the second-level timestamps show the opposite. Only the Membership Gift Card (added 2026-06-19, updated 2026-09-01) is a genuinely separate touch. (2) THE PUBLIC SITE IS FROZEN. /home?format=json-pretty gives collection.updatedOn = 2026-01-05T14:29:53Z (8 months ago); the store collection itself updatedOn = 2024-08-13; sitemap.xml has /memberships 2025-03-13, /price-list-original 2024-11-12, /price-list-original-1 2024-09-25. Twelve URLs in total, no events, no blog, no news. (3) 'NOW OPEN!' IS AT LEAST 21 MONTHS OLD. The Wayback capture of 2024-12-02 is the same page: same 'WHERE CIGARS RULE', same 'Now Open!', same 936 Broad St, same phone -- only the Fri-Sat closing time and a proprietors line differ. And 'Copyright 2026' is worthless: the 2024 capture says 'Copyright 2024', so it is a Squarespace template variable, exactly the auto-year the sweep rules discount. (4) THE ONE THIRD-PARTY DATASET DECLINES TO CALL IT OPEN. Overture/Meta id c71a8e84-d867-4704-9e40-8a29f28680ad has operating_status NULL and confidence 0.2365 -- the weakest record among all 26 Newark/Belleville tobacco places in the corpus, where the same dataset marks The Cave Cigar Lounge, Railroad Cigars, Casa del Tabaco and Bob Smoke Shop 'open' at 0.99 and even marks Brother's Smoke Shop 'permanently_closed'. It can express these states and withholds 'open' here. Its listed contact email is sbartley@techworld400.net, not a shop address. (5) NO INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION EXISTS THAT I COULD REACH: Yelp, Google, Facebook (page 459024903963471) and Instagram (@theexecutiveleaf, the site's only social account, added 2024-08-06) all refused; Wayback holds only two captures of this domain ever, both 18+ months old; there are no archived review pages. (6) SCOPE DOUBT ON TOP. The store sells nothing but memberships ($100-$3,540), locker sales are 'contact us' only, VIP members get '24 hour access', and the footer reads 'Management reserves the right to be selective' -- a private members' club in a downtown office building rather than a shop a directory user can walk into and buy a cigar. Burden of proof is on open; it is not met.

decisions.name: Sunset Cigar Lounge
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: Refuted. The only evidence of life anywhere is the shop's own single-page Wix site, and its dated content is not an 'event list' at all — it is an embedded Instagram feed from @sunsetcigarlv. I pulled the post timestamps straight out of the page source: 30 posts running 2025-08-12 through 2026-04-07, at a steady two-to-four per month (Rocky Patel night 20 Nov, Christmas party 18 Dec, 1-Year Anniversary 22 Jan 2026, Big Game 8 Feb, CAO/Macanudo/Cohiba 26 Feb, St Patrick's, membership pitch 9 Mar, NCAA game day 2 Apr, 'new inventory just in today' 7 Apr 2026) — and then nothing at all for the five-plus months since. A lounge that posts weekly and then goes completely silent is the classic signature of one that has stopped trading; the researcher's 'latest dated item ~7 months old, inside the window' understated how weak this is, because the window is being measured against a feed that simply stopped. Second, and worse: the web address the lounge prints in every single one of those posts, sunsetcigarloungelv.com, now 301-redirects to darkstarequitymanagement.com, an unrelated equity-management site (which itself returns 403). Third, the site footer still reads '© 2025 updated by THE STAFF of Sunset Cigar Lounge' — never rolled to 2026. Fourth, no third-party listing exists anywhere I could reach: BBB returns 15 cigar businesses in Henderson NV and Sunset is not among them; Yellow Pages' Henderson cigar list does not carry it (it does carry Hawaiian Smoke Shop at 565 Marks St Ste 100, next door); OpenStreetMap has POIs for the same plaza including Break & Fix at 565 Marks Street Suite 110 mapped 2026-05-02, but nothing at Suite 150; the Internet Archive has only two captures of sunsetcigarlv.com ever, both from 2025 (11 Apr and 13 Jul), none in 2026. Finally the directory's phone (725) 240-1932 does not even match the site's (725) 204-1932. Open-hours and humidor/locker copy on a Wix page that nobody has touched since spring is not proof of trading, and on the owner's rule (drop a good shop rather than keep a dead one) this one goes.

Independent third-party: New York State Dept of Taxation & Finance 'Registered Retail Dealers of Cigarettes and Tobacco Products and Vapor Products' (data.ny.gov dataset 55xf-9jat, dataset refreshed 2026-09-07, six days ago) lists THE WELTON ROOM LLC at 492 ALBANY SHAKER RD, LOUDONVILLE 12211, registration type CIG, with null susp_beg_dt and susp_end_dt (no suspension). I specifically tried to break the other researcher's 'seasonal hours means someone edited the site this year' argument and it survived: the Wayback capture of 2025-11-19 shows a completely different, older website (a GoDaddy-style build reading 'Business hours: Tuesday through Sunday 11:00am to 8:00pm' and 'Copyright (c) 2024 The Welton Room'), whereas the live site is a new Wix build with a shop, gift cards, memberships, an FAQ and the 'Summer Hours (July/August)' banner - so the site was genuinely rebuilt in 2026 and the seasonal banner is a 2026 edit, not a stale leftover. Scope: the FAQ confirms a walk-in lounge open to the public with 'a large humidor with a carefully curated selection of premium cigars', requires that all cigars smoked there be bought there, allows pipes and explicitly bans cigarettes; 'Our Story' gives a grand opening of March 16 2025 and says they are still building boutique cigar inventory. Two notes for the directory rather than reasons to drop it: the listing's city should read Loudonville, NY 12211 (the shop's own address) rather than Albany, and the only stale thing on the site is the July/August hours banner, now about two weeks out of date.

decisions.name: Aroma Cigar Room
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED on staleness, not on a closure marker. I re-verified the registry claim independently (live Socrata query of data.ny.gov dataset 55xf-9jat, rows refreshed 2026-09-07): AROMA CIGAR ROOM LLC, 791 STATE ROUTE 17M STE 11, MONROE, with null susp_beg_dt/susp_end_dt. But that dataset has NO status column at all - the researcher's "status ACTIVE" is just presence in a roster of registered cigarette/tobacco/vapor retailers; it carries no per-record date and does not distinguish a cigar lounge from a vape or convenience retailer. Against that, every dated artefact on the shop's own site is dead: I fetched https://www.aromacigarroom.com/event-calendar on 2026-09-13 and it renders "No events at the moment"; the Wix sub-sitemaps give a newest event page of 2024-01-14 ("big-game-2024"), newest blog post 2021-12-29, newest store product 2023-12-17; the online shop sells only apparel (hoodies, beanies, caps), no cigars; footer still "(c)2021 by aromacigarroom.com". The pages-sitemap date of 2025-12-09 is a bulk Wix republish stamp applied identically to all 16 pages, not per-page editing. OSM has no POI for it - 791 Route 17M resolves to a Domino's in a strip plaza (nodes fetched from api.openstreetmap.org). YellowPages still carries the name/address/phone but YP listings persist after closure and it shows no review or date. I could not reach Yelp (403), Google, Facebook (400), Instagram (login wall), Reddit (403) or any general search engine from this environment, so I have NO review-recency data either way. Net: no dated evidence of trading since January 2024, and the sole open-signal is an undated roster row. Burden of proof on "open" is not met.

decisions.name: Martinez Handmade Cigars
decisions.reason: CONFIRMED trading and in scope. Independent of the researcher's route, the site has been completely rebuilt: martinezcigars.com was WordPress as recently as Aug 2025 (Wayback shows /wp-content/ and /wp-json/wp/v2/product/35 captures through 2025-08-24) and is now a Wix site whose pages-sitemap.xml gives lastmod 2026-09-11 for EVERY page - i.e. republished two days before I checked (2026-09-13). Footer "(c) 2026 by Martinez Cigars"; /contact-us publishes 171 West 29th Street, New York NY 10001, t: 212-239-4049, retail hours Mon-Fri 7am-7pm / Sat 10am-6pm / Sun 10am-5pm; a homepage testimonial says the shop has "been around for 52 years" (1974 + 52 = 2026). Third-party corroboration: OpenStreetMap node at addr 171 West 29th Street tagged shop=tobacco, name "Martinez Cigars", phone +1-212-239-4049, website https://martinezcigars.com, opening_hours matching the site exactly. My own live query of data.ny.gov 55xf-9jat (refreshed 2026-09-07) returns JESUS A MARTINEZ, dba MARTINEZ HAND ROLLED CIGARS, 171 W 29TH ST, no suspension/revocation dates. Scope: it is a maker, but with a genuine retail storefront (retail hours, a SHOP nav, walk-in customer testimonials, OSM shop=tobacco) and cigars are the entire trade - so the "makers with no retail storefront" exclusion does not bite. One caveat for the directory, not a refutation: a SEPARATE tobacco dealer is registered at the same street number - DHIRAJ NEWS LLC (both CIG and VAPE registrations, 171 W 29TH ST), which OSM records as "Diraj News", shop=tobacco. That is a different unit/business and must not be conflated with Martinez.

The positives are all passive hosted artifacts that survive a venue closing: account_paused false, premium_service true, and a live careers form for Barback/Bartender/Tobacconist, which is boilerplate on every SpotHopper template. decisions.name: Tulsa Hills Cigar Cellar & Market
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED on doubt, though this is the closest call of the five and I found real evidence in its favour that the parent should weigh. In its favour: scope is clean - despite the WineFetch platform's misleading '/wines/' URL paths, every catalog section is tobacco (Cigars + Tobacco, Pipe Tobacco, Pipes, Humidors, Humidification, Ashtrays, Cigar Accessories), with no vape, glass, CBD or convenience lines, so it is a genuine tobacconist and the 'Market' in the name is not a corner store. I also disproved 'frozen catalog': product pages carry live per-item stock (one item's quantity guard caps at 17 units), and comparing page 1 of /cigars/ across three points in time shows genuine mid-alphabet additions absent in April 2026 (AJ Fernandez Bella Artes Maduro Lancero, AJ Fernandez New World Conn Toro, Alec Bradley Magic Toast Toro, Ashton Small Cigars Connecticut Half Corona), which implies actual restocking. Against that: the inventory is in sustained, monotonic decline - /cigars/ ran 49 pages in Jun 2025, 40 pages in Apr 2026 and 37 pages today, with the 'Under $10' facet falling 255 -> 190 -> 167 and 'Over $100' falling 22 -> 14 -> 12, roughly a 25% contraction in 15 months with no sign of reversal. And there is still zero human-authored dated content anywhere: no events, no news, no blog, and the 'Here's what we're smoking (on Instagram @TulsaHillsCigar)' embed renders nothing. The copyright year and hours are template-generated, and the site still fires a deprecated Universal Analytics tag (dead since 2023), so nobody has touched the setup in three-plus years. Given the owner's rule that doubt favours dropping, a shrinking catalog with no dated proof of a trading storefront is not enough to keep.

decisions.name: Black Cat Cigars II
decisions.where: 46 W Germantown Pike, East Norriton Twp, PA, 19401
decisions.reason: Could not refute; independently confirmed open and in scope. (1) Government registry, not the shop's own word: the PA Department of Revenue cigarette/OTP licence file (data.pa.gov resource ut72-sft8) carries a CURRENT 'Cigarette/OTP Retail' licence at the exact door — street_address '46 W GERMANTOWN PIKE', city 'EAST NORRITON', postal_code '19401-1565', licensee CAPRICORN TOBACCO INC, expiration_date 2027-02-28. Every row in that file expires 2027-02-28, i.e. it is the licence year now in force (Mar 2026-Feb 2027), so this is a licence somebody paid for and renewed in 2026. That also disposes of the 'different business now at the address' worry: the only licensed tobacco retailer at 46 W Germantown Pike is this one. (2) Live trade today, checked independently of the researcher's sitemap claim: the Shopify products.json endpoint returns updated_at '2026-09-13T19:12:21-04:00' (today) across products, and 'Arturo Fuente Opus X Angel's Share' with created_at '2026-09-04T12:03:04-04:00' — a new premium-cigar SKU added nine days ago. (3) Scope is clean: the about page says they run 'a cigar store and cigar lounge in East Norriton, Pennsylvania' and explicitly states they do NOT sell cigarettes; the trade is premium cigars, pipe tobacco and accessories. Not a vape/smoke/head shop. Caveats, none fatal: the licence trade name is CAPRICORN TOBACCO INC rather than 'Black Cat', which is a name mismatch on the licence (almost certainly the holding entity — phone (484) 322-0800 on the listing matches the site) ; the 'II' in the listing name suggests a second location but the listing address is the same single store the site advertises, so this may be a duplicate of another Black Cat row — a dedupe question, not an open/closed one. Limitation: Yelp, Google and TripAdvisor all returned 403 to direct fetch and the session's web-search budget was exhausted, so I could not check review recency or a 'permanently closed' marker on those platforms.

decisions.name: Leaf Cigar Bar
decisions.reason: Could not refute, though this is the weakest of the five. What confirmed it: (1) The staleness the other researcher flagged is misleading. The WordPress REST API (wp-json/wp/v2/pages, ordered by modified) shows 'Cocktail Menu' modified 2026-05-11T10:56:19 and 'Leaf Cigar Bar & Restaurant Lounge' modified 2026-05-11T10:54:42 — the venue's own menu and lounge pages were edited four months ago, in 2026. The 2024 copyright, the 2023-08-15 sitemap lastmod and the 2022/08 logo asset are just untouched furniture on an old theme. (2) famous-smoke.com, a demonstrably current large retailer, still puts '90 Mort Drive, Easton, PA 18040' in its footer and its only 'Retail Store' nav link points to https://www.leafcigarbar.com — fetched today, 2026-09-13. (3) The location-hours page still publishes separate live hours for the retail store (Mon-Sun 10am-7pm) and the Leaf Cigar Bar & Lounge (Thu-Sat 12pm-11pm, Sun 12pm-8pm) with no closure, suspension or renovation notice. (4) FAMOUS SMOKE SHOP PA INC holds a current PA licence at '90 MORT DR', EASTON 18040, expiration_date 2027-02-28. (5) Scope: it is the cigar bar and lounge inside a cigar superstore ('world's largest on-site humidor'); cigars are the entire trade. Real doubts I turned up and could not fully clear: (a) the PA licence at 90 Mort Dr is type 'CSA/OTP Wholesaler' — there is NO retail tobacco licence at that address, and no 'LEAF CIGAR' licence anywhere in PA. For contrast I checked a comparable Philadelphia cigar house: HOLTS CIGAR COMPANY holds 'Cigarette/OTP Retail' at BOTH its Townsend Rd warehouse and its 1522 Walnut St store. Famous holds wholesale only. That may simply be how a stamping agency is licensed, but it is a genuine unexplained gap. (b) the events calendar renders September 2026 and says 'There are no upcoming events' — odd for a cigar bar, and the wp-json posts endpoint returned an empty array, so there is no blog activity at all. (c) this is very likely the same premises as a separate 'Famous Smoke Shop' listing — a dedupe risk. Limitation: Yelp returned 403 and search was unavailable, so no review-recency or 'permanently closed' check. On balance the live parent-site link plus the May 2026 page edits plus the active licence outweigh the stale shell, so I did not refute — but this is the one I would re-check first.

That is a regulator attesting to an active cigar retailer. (2) SITE-INFRASTRUCTURE, not marketing copy (I did not rely on the first researcher's homepage read): the WordPress sitemaps show ~50 event posts in an unbroken cadence from Dec 2024 through Sept 2026, newest lastmod 2026-09-04 — nine days before today — plus an image asset under /wp-content/uploads/2026/09/. decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED — there is no evidence this business has done anything at all in 2026. The site is demonstrably dormant: cigarauthorityofchester.com is a Wix site whose own page source carries "publishedDate":"2025-10-28T20:19:25.849Z" and "siteRevision":4 — it has been published four times in its life and not once in the last 10.5 months. The sitemap index agrees: event pages lastmod 2025-10-28, blog 2024-12-26, main pages 2024-02-17, and nothing newer. The footer reads ©2024. The only events on the whole site are Rocky Patel (Apr 2024), Nick Perdomo (May 2024) and Southern Draw (Nov 13 2025). The Wayback Machine's last capture of the domain is 2024-12-14. There is no social feed — the only Facebook link is a bare facebook.com/profile.php?id=61556350181259 — and BBB has no listing for it. THE ORIGINAL RESEARCHER'S CURRENCY CLAIM DOES NOT HOLD: they cited the licence 'expiration 2027-02-28, daily file refreshed 2026-09-12', but I checked the local PA file and ALL 17,088 records are status 'Active' with expiry '2027-02-28' — that is the shared PA licence-year end, not a per-business fact, and it proves only that someone paid the renewal that took effect around 1 March 2026. A shop that shut its doors any time in spring or summer 2026 would look exactly like this. The refresh date belongs to the file, not to the business. Secondary scope wrinkle: alongside cigars the site sells cigarette tobacco and disposable/rechargeable e-cigarettes, so it is not purely a cigar house. What I could NOT find: no 'permanently closed' marker anywhere (Yelp, Google, Facebook and TripAdvisor are all 403 to me and the web-search budget was spent, so absence of a closure marker means nothing here), and OSM way 686465064 still maps 'Cigar Authority of Chester' shop=tobacco at 3177 Limestone Road with no replacement business — but that node was last edited 2024-09-19, so it is no fresher than the rest. Given the owner would rather drop a good shop than keep a dead one, ten and a half months of total silence with zero 2026 evidence is enough to pull this.

decisions.name: Broadway Cigar
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED on two independent grounds. (A) THE 'OPEN' EVIDENCE BELONGS TO A DIFFERENT COMPANY IN ANOTHER STATE. The record's website is broadwaycigars.com; the other researcher's proof came from broadwaycigar.com/pages/summer-cigar-dinner. I fetched all four host variants — broadwaycigars.com, www.broadwaycigars.com, broadwaycigar.com and www.broadwaycigar.com ALL 301 to https://broadwaycigar.com/, a Shopify store titled 'Broadway Cigars' whose only addresses are 3615 NE Broadway, Portland, OR 97232 and 15561 Boones Ferry Rd, Lake Oswego, OR 97035. The word 'Providence' and the string '02903' appear ZERO times on it; 'Portland' appears 4 times and 'Oregon' once. So the 'Summer Cigar Dinner, Friday August 14th' and the Shopify footer are the Oregon company's, and say nothing about 186 Broadway, Providence. Corroborating: the Willamette Week feature on 'Broadway Cigar Company' is Portland, and Instagram @broadwaycigar is 'Broadway Cigar Co.' (Portland). Wayback CDX for broadwaycigars.com shows it DID once host the Providence shop — the 13 Sep 2018 capture reads 'Our website is coming soon… 186 Broadway, Providence, RI 02903, (401) 272-9600' — then an error page on 22 Sep 2019, NOTHING captured 2020-2024, and a 301 by 10 Jul 2025. The domain has been dead-then-taken-over for roughly six years. (B) THE RHODE ISLAND ENTITY IS REVOKED. RI Secretary of State entity summary ID 000792136, 'BROADWAY CIGARS, LLC', 186 BROADWAY, PROVIDENCE, RI 02903, organized 08-01-2012, shows 'Date of Revocation Certificate: 12-29-2020'. In the SOS search it returns 'No records found' under ACTIVE status and returns hits only under INACTIVE — I ran the identical search shape against the other three shops, which all came back ACTIVE, so this is a real distinction and not a query artifact. (C) NO RECENT SIGNAL OF TRADING: the newest datable content on Facebook /BroadwayCigars is an event for 'Monday, May 20th' (May 20 last fell on a Monday in 2019/2024, with no year given); Foursquare shows 6 tips from 48 visitors; the Untappd venue (id 2163947) is unverified and still points at the hijacked www.broadwaycigars.com; Restaurant Guru has just 6 reviews at 3.6. I found NOTHING dated 2025 or 2026 for the Providence address. NOTE: the 'CLOSED' in the MapQuest page title is MapQuest's current-hours convention, not a permanent-closure flag — I checked and discounted it; the refutation rests on the revoked LLC and the misattributed website, not on that. Separately, a distinct business 'Broadway on Valley Cigar Lounge' now operates in Providence, which fits the pattern of the original having gone.

decisions.name: Torch Cigar Pub
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: REFUTED on two grounds. (1) None of the openness evidence is datable. torchcigarpub.com/sitemap.xml carries NO <lastmod> on any URL, and I could not find a single four-digit year anywhere on the site - no copyright year, no 'established', nothing. The 'September Newsletter is Here!' headline is a pop-up promotion (its link is '...?source=pop_up&spot_id=246739&promotion=custom_promotion'), which is static owner-configured copy that persists until manually changed and carries no year. The events page lists exactly ONE event, 'Halloween / Saturday October 31st', with no year; 31 October falls on a Saturday in 2020 and 2015 as well as 2026, so a page untouched since 2020 would read identically. There is no forward-looking content that could only have been authored in 2026. (2) SCOPE. The owner's rule requires the PRIMARY trade to be cigars/pipe tobacco. Torch's whole site is a bar: the sitemap's only content pages are food menu, drink menu, happy-hours-and-specials, party bookings, events and accessibility. There is no cigar list, no humidor page, no cigar pricing anywhere - cigars appear only as slideshow images captioned 'Cigars' and 'In our humidor'. Third-party classification agrees: the repo's Overture/Meta record (id c6695747-f74b-4d54-9156-5b9fa52bc95a) gives taxonomy_primary 'cocktail_bar' and basic_category 'bar' (alt: lounge, bar - notably NOT tobacco_shop), and OSM (w354951967) tags it amenity=pub. The business itself says 'Is it a pub? Is it a cigar lounge? Yes. It's both.' It is a downtown Greenville pub with a humidor, 8 TVs, trivia nights and live music, 21+, at 500 E Park Ave - a drinks-and-food-led venue, not a tobacconist. The original researcher flagged it as borderline; under a rule where doubt refutes, borderline plus zero datable freshness evidence is a refute.

decisions.name: Deadwood Tobacco Co.
decisions.reason: Could not refute - and I resolved the original researcher's open caveat with third-party dated evidence. Songkick's venue page for 'Deadwood Tobacco Company', address '715 Main St., 57732, Deadwood, SD, US', lists past concerts at the venue on 12 August 2026 (Devon Sants and Ruthie Craft), 11 August 2026 (Rick Monroe and the Hitmen) and 9 August 2026 (Ruthie Craft). That is an independent, dated record of the room hosting booked live music five weeks ago, during the 2026 Sturgis rally window - which corroborates the '86th Sturgis Motorcycle Rally - live music 4-7 + 8-midnight daily' content and confirms the conflicting displayed post date 'August 1, 2025' is a stale WordPress publish date on refreshed copy, exactly as they suspected. Second independent source: deadwood.com, the official Deadwood visitor bureau directory, carries a live listing for 'Deadwood Tobacco Co. Cigar Bar' at 715 Main Street, phone 1-605-722-1510, describing 'a cigar lounge with imported hand-rolled cigars, pipes, tobacco, beer and wine' and 'the only bar and music venue in the Black Hills with indoor smoking'. IN SCOPE: a full-service tobacconist whose trade is cigars and pipe tobacco, with a cigar bar attached; cigarettes are one nav category among Cigars / Pipes / Pipe Tobacco / Accessories, not the business. IMPORTANT PROCESS FLAG for the directory owner: deadwoodtobacco.com/robots.txt contains 'User-agent: ClaudeBot / Disallow: /', and the site returns HTTP 403 on every path. The first-party evidence in the original claim (the /news post, the hours, the 'Orders cannot be shipped to Utah' WooCommerce notice) therefore cannot be re-verified by us and should not be relied on or re-fetched; this listing stands on the two third-party sources above instead. Minor data note: OSM (n2958099953) still records this business at the old address, 628 Lower Main Street; deadwood.com and Songkick both give 715 Main Street, the Masonic Temple location it moved to in 2023, which matches the Overture record - so 715 Main St is the correct current address.

decisions.reason: Could not refute - confirmed trading now and in scope. Independent recency: the shop's public Facebook feed (mirrored on findglocal) shows near-daily posts running 08/31/2026 through 09/08/2026, i.e. five days before today (2026-09-13). decisions.name: Southpaw Stogies
decisions.reason: Could not refute - confirmed trading now and in scope, and on stronger evidence than the original researcher had. Recency: the business's public Facebook feed (mirrored on findglocal, listed as 'Cigar Lounge and Bar', 402 E Main Street, Lebanon TN 37087) carries dated posts on 08/14, 08/24, 08/25, 09/02, 09/03, 09/04, 09/08 and 09/09/2026 - the newest four days before today - including ticket sales for a tequila-and-cigar pairing with Ferio Tego and a mezcal-and-cigar pairing. An Instagram post dated 9 Aug 2026 announces new hours ('now open on Sunday and Monday'), which matches the hours the site currently shows (1pm-9pm, to 10pm Fri-Sat), so the site is current, not stale. Provenance: Main Street Media TN reported the opening on 11 Aug 2025 - 'Southpaw Stogies brings first cigar lounge to Lebanon', 402 E. Main St., owner Wes Chandler, grown out of a mobile cigar business started April 2024 - and the Lebanon-Wilson County Chamber directory lists Southpaw Stogies LLC at that address under a cigar-lounge heading. Searches for 'closed / permanently closed / final day' returned nothing. I did chase one real doubt: the address 402 E Main St also returns Working Man Winery and a commercial lease listing ('402 E Main St E, 1700 sq ft, mixed use, NEW LISTING'). That resolves benignly - it is a mixed-use 1936 building with more than one tenant, the winery is itself still listed there and not marked moved, and Southpaw is demonstrably posting from the address this month. Scope: a cigar lounge with a curated humidor whose events are cigar pairings; craft beer, cocktails, coffee and live music are ancillary, and there is a mobile cigar lounge for events. Not a vape, head, hookah or glass shop despite the 'Best Smoke Shop in Wilson County' wording of its 2026 Main Street award. Residual weakness, flagged not fatal: the recency evidence is all first-party social content republished by a scraper; no independent customer review inside the last few weeks was reachable (Yelp and Google both blocked).

decisions.name: Patriot Cigar Lounge
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: In scope (a genuine cigar lounge with a humidor - 'Sparta's only dedicated cigar destination', no vape/head-shop signals), and it really did open on 22 Jan 2026. But every trace of it stops dead in the first week of May 2026, and two independent channels agree on that date. (1) Its Facebook page's post history, mirrored at findglocal.com/US/Sparta/896247253564931/Patriot-Cigar-Lounge, runs steadily - 01/22/2026 'officially open for business', 01/25, 01/31, 02/02, 03/03, 03/11, 03/13, 04/01, and then 05/04/2026 'May Cigar of the Month: Avo Syncro South America Ritmo' - and then nothing at all. Four months and a week of silence from a business that had posted a Cigar of the Month every single month. (2) The Squarespace sitemap at patriotcigarlounge.com/sitemap.xml carries real lastmod dates, and the newest edit anywhere on the site is /humidor at 2026-05-06; /home is 2026-03-13, /about 2026-01-10, /events 2026-01-23. The live site matches that freeze: /humidor still headlines 'May Cigar of the Month' in September, and /events still presents the 22 Jan 2026 grand opening as 'Upcoming'. So the earlier researcher's 'nothing post-dates January 2026' was wrong in detail - there is activity through early May - but the corrected picture is no better: the newest evidence of trading is 4 months old, and a monthly rotation that simply stopped is a warning sign, not a reassurance. I could not obtain any independent recency check: Yelp, Tripadvisor, Facebook and Instagram listings all exist for it but every one returned 403 or a CAPTCHA, so there is no recent review date to rebut the silence, and archive.org is unreachable from here. Nothing positively confirms it is trading now, so under 'doubt is a reason to refute' this one goes back.

decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: Doubtful on both counts - that it is open, and that it is in scope. On openness: an exact-phrase search for 'Boiler Room Smoking Lounge' returns exactly one result on the entire web, its own website. No Yelp, no Google listing, no Facebook page, no Instagram, no Foursquare, no Tripadvisor, no news, no directory entry, no reviews anywhere. That absence is meaningful because the identical search method, run minutes earlier, found Patriot Cigar Lounge on Facebook, Yelp, Tripadvisor, MapQuest, Yahoo Local, Instagram and findglocal. A downtown Austin venue supposedly open to the public Thu-Sat noon-8pm with a $40/month membership should leave some footprint; this one leaves none. Corroborating doubts: the directory's own source record (C:\Users\mason\OneDrive\Desktop\cigarApp\server\data\overture_raw.json) has operating_status null and confidence 0.265 - the weakest possible signal, against 'open' / 0.946 for Patriot; two separate Texas tobacco-registry sweeps in this repo found no licence at 311 W 7th St and matched only unrelated businesses elsewhere in Austin ('SMOKING BURNOUTS' at 2707 Rogge Ln, 'ROSE ROOM/77 DEGREES' at 11500 Rock Rose Ave); and the address itself is York Rite of Austin, a Masonic lodge that rents itself out as an event space for up to 80 guests, so the 'basement of the York Rite Building' is a sublet in someone else's building. The site is a GoDaddy template marked 'Est. 2026' over a 2025 footer copyright, /about returns 404, and its only current-looking content is 14 generic how-to articles ('Cigar Wrappers 101', 'Pipe Tobacco 101') all dumped in August 2026 - SEO filler, not evidence of a room with people in it. On scope: it states plainly that it is BYO and 'does not sell products' - 'Bring your own cigars or pipe tobacco'. Its actual trade is $40/month memberships and humidor-locker rental, not cigars or pipe tobacco, so under the owner's rule ('PRIMARY trade is cigars and/or pipe tobacco') it sells none of the thing the directory is about. That also squares with having no Texas tobacco permit, and it would not qualify for the retail-tobacco-store exemption to Austin's indoor smoking ordinance. Refute on both grounds.

decisions.name: Dallas Cigars
decisions.reason: refuted on a second look: Refuted — not because I found a closure marker, but because nothing I could reach shows it TRADING now, and its own web presence has been frozen for ~4 months. DOUBT: (a) I pulled the Wix sitemap — https://www.thedallascigars.com/pages-sitemap.xml — and all six pages (home, lounge, cigars, events, contact-4, projects-7) share one lastmod of 2026-05-21. That is a single publish event and nothing since. (b) The only dated asset on the site is an AI-generated event graphic whose filename is literally 'ChatGPT Image May 21, 2026, 11_36_47 AM.png' — made the day of that last publish, for the Drew Estate event of 'Wed | May 27, 2026', which is still presented as upcoming 3.5 months after it passed. (c) I fetched /events directly: it contains no upcoming event and no date at all beyond that same image. (d) Footer still reads '©2024'. (e) Every consumer channel was unreachable (Yelp 403, Facebook 400, Instagram web_profile_info 429, DuckDuckGo refused, Brave 429, Bing returned unrelated cached results), so there is zero evidence of a customer in the door in 2026. (f) The address has churn: 'All Cigarette and Tobacco Retailers' (yrkr-maw5) shows a PRIOR operator at the identical suite — NTX BRANDS RETAIL CORP, outlet also named 'DALLAS CIGARS', 6162 GREENVILLE AVE STE A — whose CIG/TOB permit 22003487 AND E-CIG RETAILER permit 22008618 both went INACTIVE with permit_end_date 2023-08-31, and whose sales-tax outlet carries out_of_business_date 2024-07-31 in 3kx8-uryv. So the trading name has already died once at this address, and the former operator was part vape. WHAT CUTS THE OTHER WAY, for the reviewer's benefit: the current operator JOSEY LANE SALES INC. (outlet 'DALLAS CIGARS', 6162 GREENVILLE AVE STE A, CIG/TOB RETAILER permit 15000318, begin 2023-09-01) IS in the Active Cigarette/Tobacco Retailers file refreshed today 2026-09-13, holds an active sales-tax permit (NAICS 453991, refreshed 2026-09-12), has NO out_of_business_date, no suspension/revocation record, and holds no e-cig permit; and /lounge reads as a genuine cigar lounge (locker rental, BYOB, patio, coffee, no vape/hookah/glass). So SCOPE is fine and the entity is still permitted. But a live tobacco permit proves the paperwork is current, not that the doors open — exactly the 'backed is not open' distinction. With the site abandoned since 21 May 2026, no third-party corroboration of any kind, and a dead predecessor at the same suite, this does not meet 'positively confirmed trading in September 2026'. Under the owner's rule that doubt is a reason to drop, refute. The original researcher reached the same fallback: 'If the bar is strictly trading in September 2026, downgrade this to unknown.'

FOR trading: an ACTIVE Texas tobacco permit "EZRA ZION CIGAR BAR, 103 W MAIN ST UNIT B, DECATUR" in the registry snapshot generated today; the parent brand's store ezrazionstore.com is plainly trading now (banner "SEPTEMBER EZRA CIGAR & COFFEE OF THE MONTH JUST ANNOUNCED!") and still links to ezrazioncigarbar.com in its nav. The 2026-09-13T17:53:03 updated_at is identical to the second across all 7 products, so it is an automated Shopify sync, not someone tending the shop. Net: an explicit but self-declared TEMPORARY closure marker over a storefront frozen since 2023, against a live permit and a live parent company.

decisions.name: Denton Cigar Co
decisions.reason: Could not refute, though this is where the batch's only real closure lead was. Search surfaced a Denton Cigar Company post 'The current building of Denton Cigar Company (entire building) is condemned by TxDOT's Eminent Domain for I35 expansion. We will have no choice but to move...' plus a Denton Downtowners group thread 'With Denton Cigar Co. now gone, is there some other great cigar shops in or near Denton?'. I chased the date: the eminent-domain post is stamped March 23, 2023 - three and a half years old, not a current event. The shop is demonstrably still trading: Facebook posts 09/06/2026 ('Denton Cigar Co. will be CLOSED tomorrow, September 7th for Labor Day' - a one-day holiday note, not a shutdown), 08/24, 08/17, 08/10, 08/05 (Micallef Cut and Light with Lauren Koper on Aug 14), 07/25 ('My Father La Lealtad and Undercrown 10th Anniversary are back in stock'). TABC receipts under permit MB200110809 at '100 N INTERSTATE 35 E STE 101' run through 2026-07-31 ($9,730 July 2026); TABC licence #106673000 is Active; Yelp reads 'DENTON CIGAR CO - Updated August 2026'. In scope: premium tobacconist and cigar lounge, 400+ cigars, beer/wine alongside. CAVEAT for the owner: Cigary Inc holds TWO outlets in that building - STE 101 (NAICS 722410) and STE 201 (NAICS 424940, sales-tax permit issued 2023-08-28) - and dentoncigar.com now prints its address as '100 North Interstate 35 #201'. The listing's '#101' still matches the state's current tobacco and alcohol records, but the suite number is drifting and the TxDOT I-35 widening still overhangs the site, so this one deserves a recheck sooner than most.

decisions.reason: Could not refute — this one has the hardest trading proof in the batch. Legacy files mixed beverage tax returns, and the Comptroller publishes the receipts: LEGACY CIGAR AND LOUNGE | 3130 S MAIN ST reported $51,542 in taxable sales for the period ending 2026-06-30, $51,812 for May 2026, $44,657 for April 2026, and an unbroken monthly run back through 2025. A business filing tax on half a million dollars a year of drinks through mid-2026 is trading. It also holds an active CIG/TOB retailer permit (begun 2021-03-01, present in today's active file), TABC permit RM1115705, and no out_of_business_date. I did chase a scope doubt and I am reporting it rather than hiding it: the state classifies this outlet NAICS 722511 = Full-Service Restaurants, not 453991 like every other shop in this batch, and the weekly programme is food-and-drink led (Steaks & Stogies, Half-Priced Tacos, Unwind with Wine, Ladies Night). decisions.name: CIGAR HEAVEN - Cigar Lounge
decisions.reason: NOT REFUTED, but almost every specific the prior researcher relied on is worthless or false, and the owner should know that. WHAT ACTUALLY CONFIRMS IT: (a) Texas Comptroller open data, queried live today, returns CIGAR HEAVEN LLC, trading as CIGAR HEAVEN, 850 S KOBAYASHI RD, WEBSTER, CIG/TOB RETAILER, permit_status ACTIVE, since 2025-08-20 — exact address match, and no E-CIG permit. (b) Independent third-party: Roadtrippers, which mirrors Yelp, carries the listing at the exact address and phone (281) 525-4127, shows it as 'Open now' on the stated hours, and holds two reviews dated 2026-03-29 and 2026-08-30 — the latest just two weeks ago — both describing a lounge with a large premium and boutique cigar selection. That is a recent, off-site confirmation of an open, cigar-primary lounge, so it stays. WHAT DOES NOT SURVIVE: the 'strongest in the batch' call rested on the site's own Last-Modified header and its embedded schema, and cigarsheaven.com was registered on 2026-03-29 — under six months ago, on a one-year registration, never modified since. A Last-Modified header on a site that did not exist in March proves only that someone published a website. Wayback has no capture of this domain since 2016-10-02; the 2009 captures are a different, long-dead VirtueMart cigar store and the 2015 ones are Google domain-parking script, so the domain lapsed and was re-registered. The schema's aggregateRating of 5.0 with reviewCount 196 'on Google' is self-asserted and contradicted by the only real review footprint I can find, which is 2 Yelp reviews. Its own outbound citations partly fail: the Cigar Aficionado retailer link (ID 4618564) is a soft-404 that resolves to the generic retailer-search landing page with no mention of the business, and its shisha.com listing link 404s. Its origin story is wrong too — the Comptroller shows 850 S Kobayashi Rd previously held CASA DE MONTECRISTO BY SERIOUS CIGARS (to 2023-12-31) and CIGAR DISTRIBUTORS OF TEXAS (to 2025-11-11), while CIGARS BY CDOT is an active permit in Missouri City, ~35 miles away, not a Webster lounge that changed hands. Verdict: a real, genuinely new lounge that badly oversells itself online. Confirmed distinct from id 5473 — different address, phone and permit-holding LLC.

decisions.name: Old Virginia Tobacco Co.
decisions.reason: CONFIRMED trading and in scope; I could not shake it. (1) The locations page edit is real, not a sitemap artefact: the WordPress REST API gives /our-locations/ modified 2026-09-07T22:13:13 while every other page on the site is older (homepage 2025-09-16, the Alexandria landing page /cigar-shop-alexandria-va/ 2025-06-20, contact 2024-12-04) — so it is a genuine per-page edit six days ago, not a bulk republish, and that freshly-edited page still lists 'Alexandria — 210 King St, Alexandria, VA 22314 — Mon-Thu 10am-9pm, Fri-Sat 10am-10pm, Sun 11am-8pm' among seven stores with none marked closed. (2) Continuous 2026 trade via the posts API: 2026-09-09 Fuente Fall Festival, 2026-09-08 Spades Tournament at Potomac Mills for Friday 18 Sept 2026 (I checked the calendar — 18 Sept 2026 is a Friday, five days in the future), 2026-08 Casa Carrillo Cut & Light at Seven Corners/Sterling, 2026-08 Liberty 250 Camacho tastings at Potomac Mills/Kingstowne, 2026-06 'Stories in Smoke' with Erik Stokkebye on Thu 18 June 2026 (also a real Thursday). (3) Independent of the sitemap, the Wayback capture of /our-locations/ on 2026-04-10 already carried 'Alexandria 210 King St ... 571-685-2100' — the exact phone in our record — so the branch has been listed continuously and was not quietly dropped in the September edit. (4) Third party: Yellow Pages lists 'Old VA Tobacco, 210 King St, Alexandria, VA 22314' plus the chain's other branches under 'Cigar, Cigarette & Tobacco Dealers / Pipes & Smokers Articles', 59 years in business, no closed flag. SCOPE: premium cigars and pipes — Fuente, Davidoff, Camacho, Casa Carrillo events, pipe trunk shows, lounge-etiquette and pipe-shape blog posts; not a cigarette outlet, not vape. ONE CAVEAT for the owner: no 2026 event has been held at the Old Town/Alexandria branch specifically (last Old Town mention is a Davidoff Master Roller event, Oct 2025) — Alexandria rests on the 7 Sept 2026 locations-page edit, which I consider sufficient.

decisions.name: Blacksburg Pipe and Tobacco
decisions.reason: CONFIRMED trading and in scope, on better evidence than the original researcher had. The decisive find is a dated in-store manufacturer event I had not been given: https://www.blacksburgtobacco.com/meet-erik-stokkebye/ (page lastmod 2026-08-04) — 'Meet Erik Stokkebye at Blacksburg Pipe & Tobacco, Friday, August 14 | 2:00 to 6:00 PM', roughly 30 pipes on hand (4th Generation, Chacom, Nørding), 10% off pipes and 5% off pipe tobacco, a raffle, and 'Please visit the store during the event for complete raffle rules'. I checked the calendar: 14 Aug 2026 is a Friday while 14 Aug 2025 was a Thursday, so this is unambiguously a 2026 event, held one month ago. A brand principal flying in with stock and a raffle does not happen at a shuttered storefront. It also cross-corroborates independently: Old Virginia Tobacco (a wholly unrelated Virginia shop, id 18751) posted its own Erik Stokkebye evening for Thu 18 June 2026 — the same 2026 Virginia tour, seen on two unrelated domains. Second, the page edits are STAGGERED, not a bulk re-save: contact 2026-06-15, services 06-15, reviews 06-15, areas-we-serve 06-17, yellow-sulphur-springs 06-26, about 07-02, stokkebye 08-04, gallery 08-06, homepage 08-20. Third, homepage JSON-LD carries @type Store, streetAddress '408 N Main St', Blacksburg VA 24060, tel 540-951-8457, Tue-Fri 11:00-18:00, 4.7 from 86 reviews, with footer '©2026' and an active texting line (540) 599-5072. SCOPE: Yellow Pages files it under 'Pipes & Smokers Articles / Cigar, Cigarette & Tobacco Dealers', 408 N Main St, 29 years in business, and lists it as a DIFFERENT business from Blacksburg's actual smoke/vape shops (Wild Side Smoke Shop, Herban Legend, Vigilante Vapers, Tobacco Hut and Vape) — so it is not a head or vape shop. Trade is premium cigars (Custom House, Fuente, Regius) and pipes/pipe tobacco. Only nit: the site's page chrome shows just 'Blacksburg, VA' as address (SEO template), but schema and Yellow Pages both give 408 N Main St.

Newman LeRoy Neiman 2025 2026-07-28, Stolen Throne Preakness 150 LE 2026-07-28, Call to Arms Corona bundle 2026-06-05, Regius Reserva 2024 / Castle 919 / AF Hemingway Maduro 2026-03-16, and a shop exclusive, 'The Winnie by Stolen Throne for Winston's Humidor', 2026-02-07. decisions.name: Tailored Smoke Cigar Lounge
decisions.where: 605 Pilot House Dr, Newport News, VA, 23606
decisions.reason: Could not refute, though I had to correct two of the original claims. CONFIRMED IN SCOPE: /food-menu carries a dedicated "Cigar Menu" tab listing "Cigar Partners" (Oscar Valladares, Drew Estate, Plasencia, My Fathers Cigars, Perdomo, Padron) and "Staple Brands" (Rock-A-Feller, CAO, A.J. Fernandez, Oliva, Ashton, Cohiba, Rocky Patel, Macanudo, Romeo y Julieta, Camacho, Baccarat). Homepage sells "Wide Cigar Selection" with "tobacco sommeliers"; VIP membership includes humidor locker privileges; reservations page asks you to state "SMOKING OR NON-SMOKING SECTION"; footer links Cigars For Warriors. I grepped the whole site for hookah/shisha/vape and got ZERO hits, so it is not a hookah lounge. Food, cognac and live music sit alongside a real retail cigar program. CONFIRMED TRADING, dated by server headers rather than page text: the HTTP Last-Modified on the site's own stylesheet (static.spotapps.co/web/tailoredsmokecigarloungeva--com/css/style.css) is Thu, 13 Aug 2026, and the site-wide asset cache token v1787135346 decodes to 2026-08-19 10:29 UTC. I pulled Last-Modified for all 23 gallery images: the "3 Year Anniversary Promo Flyer August 6th - August 9th" flyer was uploaded Fri, 17 Jul 2026 17:28 GMT, "Dave Hollister live August 7th 8pm" Fri, 17 Jul 2026 17:10 GMT, "Greg Nice August 8th" and the "Cigar Vendors Flyer ... August 8th" the same afternoon - i.e. uploaded in advance of events that ran five weeks ago, which independently settles the 2025-vs-2026 question (I also verified Aug 7 2026 is a Friday, Aug 7 2025 a Thursday). Homepage is actively recruiting ("We are hiring ... Join our team at Tailored Smoke Newport News"). TikTok @tsnewportnews is live (34 videos, 514 followers, bio "Known throughout the industry for providing an unparalleled cigar experience"). CORRECTIONS to the original rationale: (1) the reservations page is NOT a functional booking engine - it is a plain $25-deposit request form with no OpenTable/Resy/SevenRooms/Tock widget anywhere in the HTML; (2) "We are updating our events" is the ONLY thing on /events - the events list is empty, which is neutral-to-negative, not proof of tending. Minor flag: the footer's Google-review deep link references "639 Pilot House Drive" while the JSON-LD, header and directions link all say 605 Pilot House Drive (matching the DB record) - an internal inconsistency, probably a stale earlier address, not a closure. This is the weakest of the three: the newest artifact is ~4 weeks old and there is no forward-dated event. CAVEAT: WebSearch budget was exhausted at the start of this task and Google, Yelp, Facebook, Instagram and DuckDuckGo all refused me (403 / login wall / bot challenge), so I could NOT check for a "Permanently closed" marker or review recency on any third-party site.

decisions.name: Cigar House
decisions.reason: Could not refute, and I closed the two holes in the prior evidence. First hole: the sitemap date is NOT per-page (all four pages share lastmod 2026-09-10), so on its own it is a site-wide republish, weak evidence. I replaced it with a Wayback diff that settles it — the homepage banner is demonstrably rotated: 2024-06-16 capture reads 'Forged Tobacco Event Saturday June15th'; 2025-04-10 capture reads 'We have a Drew Estate event coming up ... enjoy the Spokane spring weather'; the live page today reads 'September Raffles! Come into Cigar House the month of September and buy any 5 AJ Fernandez Cigars for a raffle entry' — a promotion that is running right now (today is 2026-09-13). The footer Sunday hours also changed across those three captures (CLOSED -> 10-4 -> 10-2), which a dead site does not do. Second hole: the undated 'Friday October 9th' Drew Estate event was ambiguous between 2020 and 2026. The About page says 'Established in 2024', so the shop did not exist in October 2020 and the event can only be 2026-10-09, which is a Friday. Independent: Yellow Pages (fetched 2026-09-13) lists 'Cigar House, 7314 N Division St, Spokane, WA 99208, (509) 862-4971' under Cigar/Tobacco Dealers with no permanently-closed marker. Scope is clean: 'What We Offer' is premium cigars, pipe tobacco and accessories only (Padron, Oliva, Davidoff-tier brands, Peterson/Savinelli pipes), a 275 sq ft walk-in humidor and an outdoor smoking area — no vape, glass or hookah trade. Minor data note: the contact page says Sunday 10-4 while the site footer says Sunday 10-2; the listing copied 10-2.

decisions.name: Cigar Train
decisions.reason: Could not refute; confirmed as a physical shop trading this season. I fetched the anniversary product page myself: '13th Annual Customer Appreciation and Anniversary Party ... Event is July 26th from 12pm to 4pm, door open at 1130am', now sold out, with details that only make sense for a real storefront run seven weeks ago — 'The Cuban Way food truck on site', 'Kona Ice Truck (new this year)', 'we will have chairs', 'will also have paper copies in store', 'David from Cigars for Warriors will be here'. The site says founded 2013, so a 13th annual party in 2026 is arithmetically right, and 2026-07-26 was a Sunday, consistent with a special event outside their normal Tue-Sat trading. WooCommerce lastmods are per-product and varied: anniversary ticket 2026-07-26T07:51:28-08:00, 'Boot and Wing' 2026-08-17T06:53:15-08:00 (a Hooten Young x Late Arrival Club release, current stock, not legacy catalogue), /terms and /privacy 2026-02-04, footer 'Copyright 2026'. Independent: Yellow Pages (fetched 2026-09-13) lists 'Cigar Train, (509) 389-3874, 1010 W Rosewood Ave, Spokane, WA 99208' under Cigar/Tobacco Dealers with no permanently-closed marker, matching the listing's phone and address exactly. Scope is unusually clean for this rule: 'largest humidor in Spokane, with over 200 boxes on the shelf', desktop and travel humidors, lighters, butane, cutters, punches, humidity solutions, and the site explicitly positions itself as 'free of other tobacco products and paraphernalia'. It is not online-only — posted walk-in hours (Mon closed, Tue-Fri 12-6, Sat), appointments by phone or email, and coffee brewed in store. Note for the record: the static pages are frozen at 2021 lastmods; all the 2026 activity is in products, terms and events, which is normal for a small WooCommerce shop and does not change the conclusion.

decisions.name: Havana Nights Wv Cigar Bar & Grill
